## About the position

Description

At the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT), we're on a mission to translate scientific discovery into real world impact. We bring together visionary scientists, technologists, engineers, researchers, educators and innovators to tackle humanity's greatest challenges in four transformative areas:

* Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology
* Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture
* Climate Change & Managing CO2
* Artificial Intelligence & Robotics

This is ambitious work - work that demands curiosity, courage, and a relentless drive to make a difference. At EIT, you'll join a community built on excellence, innovation, tenacity, trust, and collaboration, where bold ideas become real-world breakthroughs. Together, we push boundaries, embrace complexity, and create solutions to scale ideas from lab to society. Explore more at www.eit.org .

Welcome to the Pathogen Project:

Within this ecosystem, the Pathogen Mission exemplifies EIT's commitment to transformative science. It aims to revolutionise the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases by leveraging whole genome sequencing (WGS)-based metagenomic and pathogen-specific analytical tools. This remit includes the development of a decentralised, sample-to-answer sequencing diagnostic platform for infectious diseases, enabling rapid and accurate analysis of patient samples without prior assumptions. Supported by Oracle Inc.'s cloud-computing scale and security infrastructure, the Pathogen Mission is progressing towards certified diagnostic products for deployment in laboratories, hospitals, and public health organisations worldwide.

Your Role:

At EIT we are seeking an experienced and detailed orientated Senior Scientist, Automated Diagnostic Systems to help develop a novel device-based metagenomic pathogen detection platform within the Pathogen Programme. Working at the intersection of biology, chemistry, and engineering, you will translate molecular biology workflows into automated, integrated diagnostic systems.

You'll lead the development and optimisation of workflows for nucleic acid extraction, purification, library preparation, and sample processing within a fluidic device, helping to reduce technical risk and guide the platform from proof-of-concept through to prototype.

The role involves close collaboration with engineers, chemists, and scientists across disciplines to ensure biological workflows can be robustly implemented within an automated device architecture. We're particularly interested in candidates with experience developing automated molecular diagnostics, analytical instruments, or cartridge-based platforms, and translating manual laboratory processes into scalable automated systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and execute robust experiments to generate high-quality data and inform technical decisions.
* Translate molecular biology workflows into automated processes for integration within a diagnostic platform.
* Apply Design of Experiments (DoE) and quantitative methods to optimise workflow performance.
* Develop performance metrics and analytical frameworks to support iterative platform development.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks, variability, and failure modes across integrated workflows.
* Generate insights that guide system design, including fluidics, reagents, automation, and overall architecture.
* Improve assay robustness, reproducibility, and scalability.
* Collaborate closely with biologists, chemists, and engineers to integrate biological workflows into automated systems.
* Provide technical leadership by defining experimental strategies, prioritising risks, and supporting prototype development.

Requirements

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

* PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing molecular biology workflows in industrial or translational R&D environments.
* Proven track record of automating or semi-automating molecular biology workflows.
* Experience integrating biological workflows into analytical, diagnostic, or cartridge-based platforms.
* Strong understanding of nucleic acid extraction, purification, and analysis across diverse sample types.
* Ability to design robust experiments and interpret results within complex systems.
* Experience identifying and resolving bottlenecks in integrated biochemical workflows.
* Strong understanding of assay performance, reproducibility, and quantitative development metrics.
* Experience balancing biological requirements with engineering constraints such as fluidics, automation, contamination control, and reagent stability.
* Proven ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams spanning biology, chemistry, and engineering.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

* Experience developing automated molecular diagnostic platforms from concept to prototype.
* Experience with cartridge-based sample preparation systems and workflow integration.
* Experience developing integrated analytical or diagnostic instruments.
* Experience automating sequencing library preparation workflows.
* Familiarity with sequencing-based diagnostics, metagenomics, and NGS technologies.
* Experience with Oxford Nanopore sequencing.
* Experience handling challenging clinical samples, including low biomass or inhibitor-rich specimens.
* Experience with microfluidics and miniaturised fluid handling systems.
* Experience collaborating with mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineers.
* Experience applying Design of Experiments (DoE) methodologies.
* Knowledge of surface functionalisation, biomolecule immobilisation, or material-biomolecule interactions.
* Experience evaluating contaminants, inhibitors, and residual reagents within sample preparation workflows.

Key Attributes

Scientific & Technical Expertise

* Innovative scientist with a track record of product development, translational research, patents, or publications.
* Strong systems thinker with experience developing and optimising complex biological and engineering workflows.
* Comfortable working with evolving technologies, technical uncertainty, and data-driven decision making.

Collaboration & Leadership

* Experienced in leading technical projects and working within multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong communicator, able to translate scientific insights into practical technical solutions.
* Collaborative approach with the potential to take on leadership responsibilities as the team grows.

Personal Qualities

* Curious, pragmatic, and evidence-driven.
* Organised and adaptable, with the ability to prioritise effectively in fast-paced environments.
* Resilient team player motivated by developing technologies that can transform clinical diagnostics.

Benefits

Our Benefits:

* Travel allowance
* Annual Bonus
* Pension - Employer contribution 7.5%, minimum employee contribution 5%
* Life Assurance.
* Income Protection
* Private Medical Insurance as standard for you, your partner and any dependents. Including hospital Cash Plan
* Employee discounts
* Electric car scheme
* Nursery Salary Sacrifice scheme
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Family Planning
* Neurodiversity support including advise and assessments
* Coaching & Therapy services

Working Together - What It Involves:

* You must have the right to work permanently in the UK with a willingness to travel as necessary. In certain cases, we can consider sponsorship, and this will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
* You will live in, or within easy commuting distance of, Oxford (or be willing to relocate).

# B1/B2 Licensed Engineers

**Do you want to say you helped put the next-generation UK fighter jet into service?  We’re looking for B1 and/or B2 Licensed Engineers to join our newly created team at Boscombe Down to deliver an exciting engineering programme that will see our Flight Test Aircraft contribute to the development of the UK’s Future Combat Air System (FCAS).**

**About us:**

2Excel is a high-performance aviation services business that specialises in doing difficult things well.   We have experienced significant growth since inception, and that vector shows no sign of slowing down. Spread over multiple sites, engaging in a wide variety of activities including search and rescue, charter, capability development and aircraft maintenance, our people are at the heart of our business and, therefore, our priority.

Since 2019, we have been working on our Excalibur project, a flight test aircraft created as a flying laboratory for combat air technology.  It is part of the UK’s Future Combat Air System (FCAS), which will include the core fighter being developed under the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), as well as a broader range of capabilities such as uncrewed aircraft, information systems and weapon systems.

As we enter the next phase of this project, we are seeking exceptional B1 and/or B2 Licensed Engineers to join our team to support the engineering programme at Boscombe Down in Wiltshire.

**About the role:**

Our Licensed Engineers play a crucial role in ensuring the airworthiness of our aircraft, performing maintenance tasks, and conducting inspections in compliance with regulatory standards and company procedures. Reporting to the Station Engineer, this role will generally work Monday to Friday with flexibility to accommodate emergency situations, unscheduled maintenance or project deadlines.  Key duties will include:

* Conduct scheduled and unscheduled maintenance tasks plus modifications, on our 757 aircraft, including inspections, repairs, and modifications, in accordance with approved data and regulations.
* Perform troubleshooting and fault diagnosis to identify and rectify defects in aircraft systems, avionics, and components.
* Carry out aircraft certification and release to service activities as a B1 and/or B2 Licensed Engineer, ensuring all work is completed to the required standards and documentation is accurately maintained.
* Collaborate with other maintenance personnel, engineers, and support staff to achieve efficient workflow and minimise downtime for aircraft.
* Adhere to all relevant safety protocols, procedures, and regulations, promoting a culture of safety awareness and compliance within the team.
* Flexibility to work at other 2Excel sites in line with business needs.

**About you:**

You’ll be an experienced Licensed Aircraft Engineer, holding a CAA Part 66 B1 and/or B2 Licence.  Experience of large aircraft is essential; experience and/or type rating and recency on Boeing 757 would be extremely advantageous.

You’ll have experience of working in a Part 145 MRO environment, preferably with a good mix of line, base and modification experience.

You’ll have a strong knowledge of aircraft systems, avionics, and powerplants, with the ability to interpret technical manuals and drawings.

You’ll have excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with a meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to quality outputs.

You’ll be an effective communicator, both verbal and written, and have the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

You will also need to be eligible to hold a UK Security Clearance, which is a requirement of this role.

**What we offer:**

In return, we can offer a generous salary, 25 days holiday per year from day one plus bank holidays, 5% matched Pension scheme, Group Life Insurance, Health and Wellbeing benefits including Health Care Cash Plan and an EAP, and much more.

If required, we can also provide 757 Type Rating training, which will be bonded for a period of 2 years post completion.  At present we are aiming to start this training in Mid May 2027 so looking for candidates able to start shortly before this date.

Apply using our application form and upload your CV.  You are encouraged to use the Covering Letter function to demonstrate how you meet the requirements of the role.

Accountable is the new standard for real-time financial verification that allows institutions to prove assets and liabilities privately. Built for both traditional and crypto-native markets, the platform enables counterparties to demonstrate financial health without exposing sensitive details like API keys, wallet addresses or trading strategies.

At its core is the Data Verification Network (DVN), a privacy-preserving system that powers real-time proof of both onchain and offchain activity. On top of DVN, Accountable offers Vault-as-a-Service, a framework for structuring and managing capital onchain, and the YieldApp, the first marketplace built on DVN, surfacing verifiable yield opportunities.

We're looking for a motivated frontend engineer who can turn ideas into working code quickly using modern tools. Familiarity with Web3 and DeFi, as a developer or as an active user, is a strong plus.

### What you'll do

* Build product UIs with React, Vite and TypeScript (dashboards, forms, tables, modals).
* Write clean, accessible, responsive markup with solid semantics and cross-browser support.
* Style with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.
* Visualize data for internal and product dashboards (charts and metrics).
* Integrate Web3 features such as wallet connection and EVM contract calls using wagmi or ethers.js.

* Conversational English (written communication, docs, occasional calls).

* Web3 and DeFi knowledge: how wallets, transactions and smart contracts work, and familiarity with concepts like vaults (e.g. ERC-4626), lending, yield and stablecoins.
* Experience with shadcn/ui.
* Experience with wagmi or ethers.js (working with EVM contracts).
* Experience building dashboards and charts (e.g. Recharts, Chart.js, ECharts).

### What we offer

* Real product impact and a voice in shaping the stack and solutions.

* Backend systems run reliably at scale, handling production AI traffic with low latency and high throughput.

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. # Analyst, Primary

London, England, United Kingdom

**Adams Street Partners (“Adams Street”)** is a global private markets investment manager that has nearly $76 billion\* in assets under management. The firm is 100% employee-owned, which fosters a positive and unique culture of collaboration, intellectual rigor, integrity, and a commitment to professional development. For the eighth year in a row, Adams Street was named one of Pension & Investments’ Best Places to Work in Money Management in 2025.

Employees operate as a single global team, integrating the expertise of the firm’s investment professionals across five strategies: primary investments, secondary investments, growth equity, private credit, and co-investments.  Adams Street is considered a private markets pioneer and was inducted into the Private Equity Hall of Fame in 2000.

The firm was founded more than 50 years ago, and clients include leading public and corporate pension plans, foundations, endowments, insurance companies, registered investment advisors, and high net worth individuals worldwide.

Adams Street has offices in Abu Dhabi, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Munich, Menlo Park, New York, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo and Toronto.

\**As of June 30, 2026. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. Additional information is available upon request.*

**The Opportunity**

This is a rare chance to launch your investment career at the heart of one of the most established primary investment franchises in private markets. As an Analyst on our London Primary Investments Team, you will sit alongside experienced investors evaluating the best private equity and venture capital funds in Europe and beyond – the managers backing the companies shaping the future economy.

## Description

The Global Corporate Employee Relations (GCER) team at Amazon is seeking an Employee Relations Manager to support all Corporate lines of business in the Asia Pacific, Japan and China region (APJC). This role requires an individual who can operate across the full employee relations spectrum with strong judgment and the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups - including PXT partners, Legal, business leadership, and regional subject matter experts - to drive alignment across Amazon's wide geographic and cultural scope.

The central objective of GCER is to ensure our organization's treatment of every employee is fair, respectful, and consistent with our core business values, policies, and objectives as we Strive to be Earth's Best Employer. This position balances prevention-oriented work (enhancing the employee experience, assessing organizational risk, building positive ER programs) with response-driven work (complex investigations into discrimination, harassment, and retaliation, crisis response, and time-sensitive escalations).

Critically, this role requires the ability to operate fluidly between micro-level and macro-level work, managing discrete investigations and individual conflict resolution while simultaneously maintaining the strategic perspective to recognize when unresolved issues signal broader systemic risk or have the potential to galvanize collective employee action. The ability to see around corners, connect disparate signals, and escalate before issues compound is essential to success.

The position reports to the APJC Principal of Employee Relations, and will be based in Tokyo, Japan. This is a full-time position that could require travel up to 30% of the time over the course of the year, varying based on business needs and regional support requirements.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Partnership

- Manage and resolve conflicts at all levels of the organization, developing proactive response strategies that address employee concerns at the earliest opportunity.

Expert Consultation & Coaching

- Operate with a dual lens: manage individual (micro-level) employee matters while continuously assessing whether unresolved issues could escalate into broader (macro-level) organizational risk - including collective employee action, reputational exposure, or systemic breakdowns in trust.

# Product Manager Desktop Authentication RFID Readers

**An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Product Manager Desktop Authentication RFID Readers!!**

**Location:** Cardiff, UK

**Job ID: 52101**

As Product Manager for Desktop RFID readers, you are in charge for all RFID products inside a plastic housing. You report to the Director Product Management. 

You will define strategic vision, develop the comprehensive roadmap, and establish KPIs for the Desktop products. Drawing on your expertise, customer insights, and input from business lines and Reader BU management, you'll articulate the business value and strategic rationale to ensure the product team clearly understands the purpose behind each product initiative and release. 

You will own all aspects of the product lifecycle—from initial concept through commercialization to end-of life—and lead the team in defining the product portfolio and driving its commercial success. 

Your responsibility covers proven markets and established products and their life cycle management, but part of your duties is to develop new products for new markets within the RFID authentication market, too. This requires direct collaboration with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to execute strategies that meet both business objectives and market demands. 

In this role, you will identify emerging technology trends and drive platform reuse strategies across HID's IDentification Technologies (IDT) and Physical Access Control Systems (PACS) portfolios. You'll partner with IDT business leaders, global engineering teams, and regional organizations to allocate budgets and develop comprehensive product management strategies that advance our market position.

You'll leverage the technical depth within the IDT organization to strengthen our competitive advantage while driving customer demand and nurturing key relationships. You must be passionate about technology, deeply customer-centric, and continuously attuned to industry trends in cloud platforms, physical and logical access control, and identity management. 

The ideal candidate combines a global mindset with cultural awareness, thrives in fast-paced team environments, and demonstrates strong results orientation. You bring data-driven decision-making capabilities, sharp business and commercial acumen. You have a technical understanding in EE and embedded software, but you are comfortable in navigating business driven decisions. 

**Who are we?**

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo 

**Identification Technologies (IDT):**

IDT is creating trusted identities for IoT applications through Smart Components and Enabling Services.

HID’s Identification Technologies powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things through smart components and cloud services. We make it possible for people and organizations to transact safely, work productively, and travel freely. Our contactless identification and sensing (RFID, NFC, and BLE) components and solution enabling technologies address the dynamic requirements across multiple industries to wirelessly connect, identify, collect and manage data quickly and accurately across virtually any IoT application.

**As our Product Manager Desktop Authentication RFID Readers  , you’ll support HID’s success by:**

* Manage the entire product line life cycle ensuring optimum Desktop RFID reader positioning.
* Be accountable for product/solution line profitability (Gross Contribution).
* Drives re-use and economies of scale for products, technologies and platforms.
* Apply data driven methods for prioritization and planning of requirements.
* Constantly observe the market, competition, and relevant trends to align strategies by participating in market research, visiting customers and partners, and attending trade shows.
* Participate in or initiate negotiations with key partners.
* Prioritize EPICS & Features using Scaled Agile (SAFe) process and judgement in conjunction with Product Owners (POs), Engineering Team Leaders and Business Owners.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and gain acceptance of stories to support priority features.
* Update Roadmap with plans and priorities that come out of LPM, and PI Planning processes.
* Collaborate with product management across Reader Business Unit to align strategies, drive technology reuse, and deliver integrated solutions that provide customers with an unified product experience.
* Develop and support go-to-market plans, from strategies to tactics in sync with Sales, Product Marketing and MarComm teams.
* Define and communicate the long-term product vision and multi-year strategic plan for all the product lines, including portfolio rationalization, end-of-life decisions, and strategic investment priorities aligned with business objectives .
* You participate in regular alignment meetings inside the BL (SAFe) and also in cross-BU and across companies meetings inside the Assa Abloy group.
* Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with strategic customers and key accounts.
* Be the de-facto product/solutions evangelist in cooperation with Marketing and Sales Support team.
* Support Sales in the pre-sales exercise such as specifications, recommendations to customers, white paper writing, in-field customer visits, competition analysis etc.
* Ensure regulatory compliance and prioritize product-related risks including standards certifications (FCC, CE, ISO), cybersecurity requirements, intellectual property strategy, and supply chain continuity planning.
* Represents Company in professional association responsibilities and activities in local/industry functions and events.

**Education/ or Experience**

* 3+ years’ experience as a product manager or product owner in delivering and deploying software, firmware; hardware products and/or solutions to factory.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering with a background in software, firmware and/or hardware. Alternatively related field, or equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience.
* Ability to lead a team of professionals through the product development and introduction cycle .
* Able to understand a complex technical situation. Ability to see the missing information, gather them independently and then divide the problem into sub-tasks for R&D, sales, support, production, PM etc.
* Good interpersonal communication skills, good team spirit and adaptability. Ability to talk to customer and build relationships.
* Able to work autonomously but also operate as part of a strong, cohesive team. Ability to see the required missing tasks outside the task description and either do it or delegate it.
* Familiarity with RFID technology and access control and authentication is a strong advantage.
* Knowledge of smart card reader, embedded systems, cryptography and security practices.
* Knowledge and experience in agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe®, Kanban, Lean, DevOps etc.)
* SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager (SAFe® PMPO) certificate is an advantage.

**What we can offer you:**

* Competitive salary and rewards package.
* Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance.
* A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture.
* Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential.
* To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds.

**Why apply?** 

* **Empowerment:** You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* **Innovation:** You embrace challenges and want to drive change. You'll have opportunities to share insights and contribute forward-thinking ideas that shape future outcomes.
* **Integrity:** You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

**Job Summary**   
   
The Housing Rights Support Manager is a senior role within Caring in Bristol’s adult services, supporting the delivery and development of Early Doors, our homelessness prevention project.    
   
Early Doors works with people experiencing housing issues, offering 1-1 advice and support, group training and access to specialist housing advice and support from our brilliant volunteers.    
   
The role combines a caseload and direct, person-led support with responsibility for the day-to-day coordination and quality of the Housing Rights Support team and Housing Advice Drop-in service. Support conversations are strengths-based, person-led, informative, honest and accessible, helping people improve their knowledge and confidence to use their housing rights, access, understand and take action on specialist housing advice, and identify longer-term housing goals and practical steps towards them.    
   
The Housing Rights Support Manager will line manage the Housing Rights Support Worker, ensure the smooth running of the drop-in service, and work alongside the Head of Support Services to deliver the strategic aims of the adult services.    
   
The Housing Rights Support Manager will help ensure Early Doors remains effective, accessible and responsive to the needs of Bristol’s communities. **Position Overview**

Modern AI systems increasingly depend on their ability to access and use the right context at

the right time. An important research challenge is how large, evolving bodies of information

should be represented to support reliable inference.

Autodesk Research provides a distinctive setting for this work. Construction projects are rich,

complex information environments whose state changes continuously over time, making

them a compelling domain for studying context and knowledge systems for AI.

As a Research Intern, you will own a focused research problem in this area. You will

investigate new approaches to building and retrieving structured context, develop

experimental prototypes, and evaluate how effectively they support downstream AI

reasoning.

You will work closely with Autodesk researchers and engineers and have substantial freedom

to bring ideas from your own research. Strong contributions may form the basis of an

academic publication and future Autodesk research.

  

**Responsibilities**

• Conduct original research in context and knowledge systems for AI. Investigate

methods for representing and retrieving information to support reliable contextual

inference

• Develop new approaches to context construction. Explore how relevant knowledge

can be identified and assembled dynamically from large and evolving information

environments

• Build research prototypes. Implement experimental systems using graph-based,

semantic or hybrid approaches and apply them to realistic project information

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments. Develop suitable research questions,

baselines and evaluation methods to understand the strengths and limitations of

proposed approaches

• Collaborate with Autodesk researchers and engineers. Work across AI research,

software engineering and domain expertise to refine ideas and translate them into

experimental systems

• Communicate research findings. Present results within Autodesk Research and

contribute, where appropriate, to research papers, technical reports and

demonstrations

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Data Science, Information Science or a closely related field, with at least one

academic term remaining after the internship

• Research experience in an area related to knowledge representation, information

retrieval, data management or contextual information systems for AI

• Strong programming skills and experience developing experimental research

software

• Understanding of contemporary AI systems and how retrieval and contextual

information support modern reasoning or agentic workflows

• Experience formulating research questions and designing empirical evaluations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Research experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

• Knowledge graphs or graph-based information systems

• Advanced information retrieval and hybrid retrieval methods

• Retrieval-augmented generation, including GraphRAG or related approaches

• Context engineering or memory architectures for AI systems

• Semantic and structured knowledge representation

• Temporal, provenance-aware or evolving data systems

• Heterogeneous data integration at scale

• Graph machine learning applied to representation or retrieval

A strong research publication record in a relevant area is desirable

  

Prior experience with architecture, engineering or construction is not required. We are

particularly interested in candidates with deep technical expertise who are motivated by the

opportunity to test their research against a complex real-world information environment.

  

**About the Team**

Autodesk Research explores technologies that may shape how the world is designed and

made. We work across fundamental and applied research, developing new ideas and testing

them against problems grounded in professional practice.

The Intelligent Construction team investigates how emerging forms of AI can support a more

connected and adaptive construction industry. An important part of that challenge is

understanding how fragmented project information can become a coherent and evolving

source of knowledge for intelligent systems.

You will join a multidisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning AI, data

systems, software engineering and construction. You will work closely with experienced

researchers while having substantial ownership of your own research problem.

Expected Research Outcome

This is a focused **12-week research internship**. The research question will be developed with

the successful candidate to make use of their existing expertise while addressing a problem

relevant to the team's research direction.

By the end of the internship, we expect the intern to have developed and evaluated an original

approach to a clearly defined research problem. This should include a working research

prototype, rigorous experimental evidence and a clear account of the findings and limitations.

The work will be shared within Autodesk Research. Where the research contribution warrants

it, we would expect to develop the work toward publication at an appropriate academic

venue.

Partner with the best
Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving energy and industrial customers in more than 120 countries. Consolidating and approving Technology Readiness Level (TRL) assessments for new product introductions.
Preparing Technical Maturity Assessments (TMAs) for new product development to support early customer engagement, front-end development, and tendering activities.
Governing technical maturity gap closure activities with product engineering resources.
Leading technology acceptance activities with customers for new product introductions.
Governing intellectual property assessments for new product introductions and new technology patents.
Governing product safety assessments for new product introductions.
Approving technical risks associated with new product introductions to support future risk management during project execution and delivery.
Establishing and maintaining a structured technical partnership between NPI and Execution A&C teams, including Product Engineering, Project Execution, and Services, to ensure consistent technical decisions, clear interfaces, common design practices, and seamless handover of NPI outputs into customer projects and lifecycle support.

Working jointly with discipline and product TTHs across NPI and Execution organizations to apply consistent technical governance, share specialist knowledge, resolve cross-functional technical challenges, and provide coherent technical direction to engineering teams, customers, and business stakeholders.
Supporting the wider A&C technical community by mentoring engineers across both NPI and Execution teams, maintaining knowledge-sharing mechanisms, and promoting cross-functional learning, common standards, and best practices.
Collaborating closely with manufacturing to ensure new product manufacturability.
Interfacing directly with customers and supporting Product Management by providing technical guidance, gathering feedback, clarifying requirements, and supporting the successful deployment of new product solutions.
Collaborating with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to ensure the effective development, validation, and execution of test and qualification procedures that meet technical and programme requirements.
Ensuring all NPI activities comply with engineering governance, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
Providing expert guidance on product design, validation, qualification, and industrialization.
Reviewing and supporting the preparation of technical documentation, including specifications, test plans, verification reports, and configuration deliverables.
Contributing technical insights to product roadmaps, feasibility assessments, and technology development discussions.
Mentoring engineering teams and promoting best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement in engineering and NPI processes.

Demonstrate strong technical leadership and the ability to influence engineering decisions across multidisciplinary teams.
Possess experience in the design, development, and implementation of industrial control systems and automation solutions.
Have a solid understanding of engineering standards, risk management, and product lifecycle development processes.
Be an effective communicator with strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Be able to work collaboratively within global, cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Demonstrate a commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Hybrid working arrangement, combining office-based and remote working where business needs allow.
Occasional travel to Baker Hughes facilities, customer sites, and suppliers as required.

Join Us

*Hi 👋 I’m Nitesh, Engineering Manager at hyperexponential. I'm one of the career mentors in the Product Foundations stream. We tackle the fundamental problems every product team at hx runs into, so the vertical streams can focus on building features for customers. Right now that means deployments, observability, security, AI observability tooling and a permission service that other value streams will build on.*

*I’m hiring a Senior Security Engineer to join us as our second security hire. The foundations are already in place. We’ve chosen and implemented our tooling, and our repositories and cloud environments are onboarded. The next step is shaping how security actually works here. This won’t be a traditional, hierarchical security function. Our engineers go straight to the person who owns an issue and ask them to fix it, and you’ll help define what security looks like in that model.*

*There’s no established playbook for this yet, which is what makes it exciting. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, I’d love to hear from you.*

## About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

## About the Security function

The Security function's mission is to safeguard the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of our customers' data and hx's systems. By fostering a culture of vigilance, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement, we maintain the highest standards of security excellence.

Security at hx underpins every product and every customer interaction. As we scale our multi-product platform globally and adopt AI across the business, the team ensures that innovation and growth are matched with rigorous security practices. We design controls, shape culture, and guide decisions that protect our business, our customers, and the wider industry.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you’ll be the second engineer in our security team, working directly alongside our Staff Security Engineer. The foundations are in place, with our core tooling chosen, rolled out and onboarded across our repositories and cloud environments. Much of how security works at hx is still to be built, though, so you’ll have real autonomy to shape it, with a direct line to the teams who own the issues you find. You’ll strengthen hx’s security posture by driving continuous improvement across our technical teams: owning security reviews, running and extending our security tooling, and turning findings into fixes, often by writing the code or making the infrastructure change yourself. You’ll champion security initiatives across the organisation, help teams adopt AI securely, and use AI to multiply your own impact. This role combines hands-on technical depth, ownership and influence to make security a practical part of how our teams work every day.

Check out our Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

## What you'll be doing

* Modify, maintain, and extend our security tooling across engineering and IT environments, including CSPM, SAST, SCA, and secret scanning, ensuring it's reliable, well tuned, and genuinely useful to the teams who depend on it.
* Use our tooling and your own judgement to proactively identify gaps across cloud security, dependencies, secrets, and code. Work with the owning teams (starting with 2 to 3 where the gaps are greatest) to secure their commitment to prioritise remediation, and see it through.
* Write code and make infrastructure changes yourself to fix security issues and improve our tooling, rather than just recommending improvements.
* Own security reviews end to end, partnering with engineering teams on new designs, significant changes, and new tools, and working through follow-up questions and challenges until each review is resolved.
* Take ownership of and complete a medium-sized security project within your first three months.
* Partner with our IT team on security best practice, helping implement practical improvements in authentication, authorisation, and security hygiene across our corporate environment.
* Guide teams across the business on adopting AI securely, from assessing new AI tools and use cases to mitigating risks like data leakage and prompt injection, while using AI yourself to increase your impact.
* Support our compliance programmes, such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, by helping teams implement and evidence technical controls.
* Act as a trusted voice for our technical teams, owning security issues raised with them through to resolution and handling the related correspondence.

## What you'll need to have done

* Secured AWS cloud environments hands-on: using Cloud Security tooling to find common weaknesses, and fixing them yourself through infrastructure and code changes. Cloud Security experience is required.
* Secured containerised workloads and infrastructure-as-code, catching issues before they reach production.
* Experience working with SAST, SCA, and secret scanning tools, including triaging findings, filtering out false positives, and partnering with engineering teams to get real fixes shipped
* Supported compliance efforts such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or GDPR by implementing and evidencing technical controls.
* Used AI to improve your own security work and helped others adopt it safely, with a practical understanding of AI-specific risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, and agents and integrations with excessive permissions.
* Spotted and addressed non-technical risks, such as weak processes, risky behaviours, and gaps between teams, that can undermine technical security.
* Discussed security in depth with engineering teams, explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely and influencing teams through to implementation.
* Taken ownership of security projects and initiatives and driven them to completion independently.

## You're unlikely to thrive here if

* You prefer to advise from the sidelines rather than writing code and making the infrastructure changes yourself.
* You see security as a gatekeeping function rather than a service to the teams you support, whose adoption and trust determine your success.
* You'd rather wait for direction than take ownership of issues, follow them through to resolution, and manage the correspondence around them.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

## Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Cancer Research UK’s Centre for Drug Development (CDD) is seeking an experienced and strategic **Project Leaders Team Lead** to oversee the successful delivery of a diverse portfolio of oncology drug development projects.

* Proven people leadership experience, with a track record of developing, motivating and managing high-performing teams. # Application Support Analyst

Manchester, United Kingdom

(Hybrid)

## Job Description

Canopius is due to go live with Workday Financials in Q1 2027 following the migration of key Finance processes to the new platform. The Workday Data Analyst will join the Application Support team to support the implementation of Workday Financials, working alongside the Workday project team.  The role will provide specialist technical support, with a primary focus on Prism Analytics, Accounting Centre and the end-to-end movement of data into and through Workday.

The role will focus on UAT, go-live and the post-go-live period, working with Finance, Data, IT, project teams and third-party suppliers to investigate and resolve data-related issues. During go-live and post-go-live support, the role will help stabilise the service through rapid triage, root-cause analysis and fix-forward activity, while contributing to the future support model and transition into BAU.

The successful candidate will bring relevant Workday and data experience into the project and share their knowledge with the permanent role and wider Business Applications function. They will create practical documentation, support knowledge transfer and provide initial basic training and support to help AMS prepare for ongoing live service.

This is a hybrid role, working 2-3 days per week from our Manchester office.

Responsibilities:

* Provide second-line technical support for Workday data services, including Prism Analytics, Accounting Centre and associated data pipelines.

* Investigate and resolve data quality issues, processing failures, reconciliation differences and incidents affecting financial outputs.

* Use SQL and other appropriate diagnostic tools to analyse data, identify root causes and support effective resolution.

* Understand and support the end-to-end movement and transformation of data between source systems, data platforms and Workday Financials.

* Support interfaces feeding Workday, including assessing the impact of source-system, configuration and data-structure changes.

* Provide technical analysis for complex incidents and work with Finance, Data, IT and third-party suppliers to restore service.

* Support Workday Financials UAT, go-live, fix-forward activity and the transition from project delivery into a stable live-support service.

* Support controlled changes and releases by completing impact assessments, technical testing, implementation activities and post-implementation validation.

* Create and maintain clear support documentation, operational procedures and troubleshooting guidance.

* Share specialist knowledge across the wider Business Applications team through coaching, documentation and collaborative problem-solving.

* Provide knowledge transfer, initial training and practical support to the wider AMS team to build readiness for Workday live support.

* Work closely with the project team to triage defects, assess data impacts and support timely resolution during UAT, go-live and post-go-live stabilisation.

Skills and experience:

* Practical experience supporting data-intensive business applications in a live-service environment.
* Experience of Workday Prism Analytics, Workday Accounting Centre or comparable enterprise data and financial platforms is highly desirable.
* Strong SQL skills and experience investigating data quality, transformation, integration and processing issues.
* Understanding of data pipelines, interfaces, source-to-target mappings and end-to-end data flows.
* Experience supporting UAT, go-live, fix-forward, hypercare or transition-to-service activities for a major system implementation.
* Experience working within structured IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change and release management.
* Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear guidance for users, support colleagues and stakeholders.
* Experience creating support documentation, knowledge articles and operational procedures.
* A collaborative approach, with the confidence to share knowledge and help build capability across the wider team.
* Ability to work effectively in a project environment, prioritising defects and issues during critical delivery and stabilisation periods.
* Experience transferring knowledge to permanent support teams through training, documentation and collaborative problem-solving.
* Awareness of access controls, segregation of duties and audit requirements within financial systems would be advantageous.

## What you would actually do.

#### We're hiring Full-Stack Engineers to build Descrial end to end, from the database to the interface. Our clients trust us with confidential financial data, so security, tenant isolation, auditability and a polished experience are engineering constraints, not extras.

You'll work in TypeScript and React on the front end, Python (FastAPI or Django) on the back end and PostgreSQL on AWS. This role is part of a nine-person engineering cohort being hired across full-stack, front-end and back-end.

### About Descrial

#### Descrial is a startup inside a twenty-year-old company

TresVista has run the analytical work behind private capital since 2006. 2,000 people, 400+ clients including some of the biggest names in the industry, no outside capital and no outside board. That was the first chapter. And we enjoyed getting here!

#### The next chapter is harder and more interesting

We are moving from services to software, from one firm's workflows to an industry's, and from executing investment decisions to shaping how they get made. Thirty of us in King's Cross, small and senior, with day one founder intensity.

At its fullest expression, Descrial changes how every serious investment firm decides.

### The role

You report to the Head of Engineering and join the UK core team. You own features from schema to screen, set technical direction where it matters and ship in short cycles with product managers, designers, QA and our client-facing teams.

### Your remit

#### The product surfaces

You build data-heavy interfaces in TypeScript and React, making sound choices on server or client rendering and on state management with Redux, Zustand, TanStack Query or similar. You turn product requirements and Figma designs into accessible, consistent UI and help grow a shared component library. The interface respects a detailed role- and permission-based access model, and real-time views over WebSockets handle loading, empty, error and stale-data states with care.

#### The services and data

You design and build REST services in async Python with FastAPI or Django and Pydantic, with clear OpenAPI contracts and backwards-compatible changes. You model domain data in PostgreSQL, covering schema design, migrations, indexing, query tuning and multi-tenant isolation, and use Redis and OpenSearch or Elasticsearch where they fit. You build event-driven and background processing with queues such as SQS or Celery, including retries, idempotency, search indexing, audit events and notifications.

You implement authentication and authorisation end to end: SSO, OTP, session and JWT handling, and role-based checks on every request. Security and compliance (SOC 2, UK GDPR) shape the work: tenant isolation, least-privilege access, audit logging and secure file handling. You build integrations with the systems our clients use, such as Microsoft 365 through the Graph API (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint), CRMs, HR systems and document stores, using OAuth and careful secrets handling.

#### The AI experience

You work with the AI/ML team to bring LLM-powered features into the product. You build the Python layer between the product and our AI services, including streaming responses, document processing endpoints and safe access for AI agents to internal services through MCP. You design the experience around AI output so investment professionals can trust and audit it, with source citations, clear provenance, edit and approve flows, feedback capture and graceful failure handling.

#### The quality and delivery

You write well-tested code (unit, component and end-to-end), take part in thorough code review and keep the CI/CD quality gates healthy. You own front-end performance for what you ship. You deploy and operate services on AWS with containers and Kubernetes, S3, SQS and EventBridge, instrument them with logs, metrics and traces, and help fix production issues.

### Your experience

* 5+ years in software engineering, with real full-stack ownership of features in production.
* Strong TypeScript and React.
* Strong Python backend experience with FastAPI or Django in production.
* Strong PostgreSQL data modelling and SQL, using SQLAlchemy and Alembic, the Django ORM or similar.
* Have built authentication and access control in a multi-tenant B2B product.
* Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud, CI/CD and containers.
* Track record of setting technical direction and leading architecture decisions.
* Use of AI coding tools daily, such as Cursor or Claude Code and have a considered view of where they help.
* Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

### Useful to have, none required

* Next.js and Node.js (TypeScript) in production
* An eye for layout, visual hierarchy and interaction, and sound UX judgement when there is no designer in the loop
* Product features built on LLMs, including model APIs, streaming, LangChain or LangGraph, and MCP
* Background task queues, real-time features, Redis and OpenSearch or Elasticsearch
* Java/Spring Boot, Kubernetes or Terraform
* SOC 2, regulated environments or financial-services products

### The reality

This will be difficult.

It demands pace and accuracy. We are building autonomous systems inside high-stakes live businesses, where decisions carry real consequences and impact and waiting for everyone to agree is not always an option.

The systems will sometimes get things wrong. In this phase the London team needs to create the evaluations, visibilities and safeguards that catch mistakes early, reducing them over time and stopping the same failures happening again.

If you want to build the foundations of an enterprise grade technology platform to service a multi-billion $ serviceable market opportunity, and share in that growth, this is your chance to join us.

### In our conversations

Come ready to discuss three pieces of work:

* A feature you owned end to end, from schema to interface, and the trade-offs you made.
* A tenant, permission or authentication boundary you implemented and tested.
* A production quality, performance or reliability problem you diagnosed across the stack and fixed.

### Compensation

The all-inclusive package is typically £85,000–£105,000 a year, depending on experience.

### Practical details

* King's Cross, London. In office (3 to 5 days a week), with colleagues in London and Bengaluru.
* Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
* We aim to finish the process within three weeks. Tell us if you need an adjustment to the interviews.
* Descrial is an equal opportunity employer.

### Apply

You do not need to meet every qualification to apply. Strong candidates bring different combinations of experience, judgement and potential, and we know that some people are more likely than others to underestimate what they could contribute. If the work interests you and you believe you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

The systems we are building will influence how important investment decisions are made. That makes a range of experiences and perspectives essential to building them responsibly. We want a team where different viewpoints are heard, respected and reflected in the work.

# Senior Data Engineer

Remote

## **Job Description**

Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets.

We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today's complex, global market. Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. We've agonized about our data model abstractions, created horizontal scalability, and crafted thoughtful APIs. All so we can provide a best-in-class experience for our clients.

By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets.

### **The Team:**

The mission of the Clear Street Active team is to provide best execution for every asset class in every market. Active is building a new, state-of-the-art, cloud-based trading platform giving high-performance traders access to liquidity venues across multiple asset classes, cutting-edge charting, and sophisticated order handling.

The Active Data team owns how the business understands itself, and increasingly how it decides what to do next. Data flows into our warehouse from ad platforms, product analytics, CRM and support systems, and the brokerage's own systems. It flows back out to the platforms that message our customers, bid for new ones, and manage relationships with them. Every hop is a place where data can be duplicated, delayed, or quietly redefined, and an error that leaves the warehouse does not stay a reporting problem. It spends ad budget on the wrong people, sends a customer the wrong message, or misstates a regulated number. Moving data is table stakes. Keeping it true as it travels is the problem this role owns. It is a small team with a wide surface area, and we are scaling it as the platform grows toward tens of thousands of accounts.

### **The Role:**

Three areas of the business depend on this role, and you will own the data for all of them:

* **Growth.** Bring in spend, clicks, and conversions from every paid, affiliate, and organic channel, reconcile them against our own records, and send funded-account outcomes back to the ad platforms, so bidding optimizes for customers who actually fund and trade.
* **Lifecycle and the user journey.** Resolve each customer's identity from a first anonymous visit through sign-up, KYC, funding, and first trade, and keep lifecycle messaging, CRM, and support systems in step with what actually happened.
* **Brokerage data.** Model account opening, KYC, funding and transfers, and trading from the platform's own systems, with the precision a regulated broker-dealer needs.

Across all three, you will:

* Own data integrity in both directions. Prove that every feed arrived complete and on time, and that every outbound sync landed what it should. A duplicated conversion inflates ad spend, a stale attribute sends the wrong message, and a broken join misstates funded accounts to leadership.
* Own the warehouse layers in dbt: raw landing, staged and identity-resolved models, and the curated models that analysts, data scientists, dashboards, and internal AI agents read from. Every model has a declared grain and tests.
* Establish data contracts with product engineering and with the owners of the platforms we depend on, so an upstream change is caught at the boundary instead of silently nulling a field three models downstream. You will define these rather than inherit them.
* Own governance: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and auditability, including self-serve tools that do not become a way around permissions.
* Choose deliberately between batch, change-data-capture, and streaming, based on what each consumer actually needs.
* Partner with Marketing, Product, and Operations to get the events and fields the business needs captured. This role is measured on whether the business's numbers are right and on time, not on pipelines delivered.

### **What We Value:**

* Engineers measured on whether the numbers are right, not on what was shipped
* Very high agency. Much of the work here begins before the requirement is clear: the source has no documentation, the field you need was never captured, and the team that owns it is busy shipping. We need someone who chases a dependency into another team and ships something reliable without a spec.
* Skepticism about data, including your own pipelines. Check grain, joins, and completeness before you trust a number.
* A preference for boring, observable systems over clever ones
* Clear communication with non-engineers: able to explain to a marketer why yesterday's number moved, and to negotiate a schema change with a product team the same afternoon
* Pragmatism: ship the version that works now, and improve it deliberately rather than waiting for the ideal one

### **Requirements:**

* Minimum five years in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production pipelines you were on the hook for when they broke
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python, and production experience with dbt in a layered warehouse: raw, staged, and curated models with a declared grain, tests, and incremental builds
* Hands-on experience bringing in third-party and application data through managed connectors, event pipelines, and change-data-capture, and handling what goes wrong with each: schema drift, resyncs, duplicates, and late or missing records
* Experience sending data back out, through reverse ETL, audiences, or conversion feeds, and owning its correctness after it leaves the warehouse
* Data quality in practice: reconciliation against systems of record, freshness and volume monitoring, and the fix that stops an incident from recurring
* Data governance in practice: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and an audit trail you could show a regulator
* Familiarity with fintech or brokerage data: account opening and KYC, funding and transfers, trades and settlement, and why superficially similar balance or status fields are not interchangeable
* Self-starter who operates well without a large team to escalate into

### **Nice To Haves:**

* Identity resolution across web, app, and account data: anonymous visitors, multiple devices, and more than one account per person
* Marketing data: ad-platform APIs, conversion APIs, click IDs, and attribution
* Lifecycle and CRM tooling, where the pipeline ends in a campaign rather than a table
* Semantic layers for BI tools and AI agents
* Workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows, Airflow, or similar), and enough Kubernetes to debug your own jobs
* Data retention and audit requirements in a regulated environment (SEC, FINRA)
* Experience being an early data engineering hire on a team that scaled

**Scope:** This role owns the data: pipelines into and out of the warehouse, the models in it, and who can see what. The trading systems, the core clearing ledger, and company infrastructure (cloud, Kubernetes, networking) are owned by engineering and infrastructure teams, and you will work closely with them.

**Active Data Stack:** Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Fivetran, Segment, Argo Workflows, Datadog

### **We Offer:**

* The opportunity to join a small and growing team of good people, where you can make a difference.
* A new, high-quality code base with little technical debt and room to build new services and features.
* A meritocratic philosophy that champions collaboration.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and perks.

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.

The Head of Women’s & Girls’ Cricket will have overall responsibility and accountability for the direction, performance and development of Women’s & Girls’ cricket at Worcestershire County Cricket Club.

The role will provide leadership across the entire Worcestershire pathway, from the youngest age groups through to the Women’s senior team, ensuring there is a clear and connected approach to identifying, developing and progressing talented players.

A key part of the structure will be the line management and development of a dedicated lead for the younger age-group pathway, who will take day-to-day responsibility for coaching and programme delivery within those age groups. The Head of Women’s & Girls’ Cricket will retain overall accountability for the quality, direction and effectiveness of the whole pathway.

The role itself will have a significant hands-on coaching and performance focus, taking direct responsibility for the coaching, development, preparation and performance of the Women’s senior team and Under-18 programme.

Our ambition is to develop our own players, build a larger group capable of thriving at Tier 2 level and give our most talented and ambitious players the skills, experience and opportunity to progress into professional cricket. Success will therefore be measured not only by results, but by the strength, depth and progression of the Worcestershire player pathway.

The postholder will be responsible for establishing the cricketing philosophy, standards, culture and environment of the senior programme - creating a team that is ambitious, competitive, enjoyable to be part of and recognised for developing players.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

· Provide overall leadership, strategy and accountability for Worcestershire Women’s & Girls’ performance cricket and the complete player pathway.

· Act as Head Coach of the Worcestershire Women’s senior team, EPP and Under-18 programme, leading coaching, training, match preparation, selection, individual player development and performance.

· Establish and lead the culture, playing philosophy, standards and expectations of the senior Women’s programme.

· Develop individual players technically, tactically, physically and mentally, with a strong emphasis on helping players maximise their potential.

· Build greater depth within the Worcestershire playing pathway, increasing the number of players capable of progressing into and succeeding within the senior team.

· Create a clear and visible pathway from junior age-group cricket through U18s and into the senior Women’s team.

· Make the development of home-grown Worcestershire players a central objective of the programme, while appropriately supplementing the squad where necessary.

· Ensure talented players with the ambition and ability to progress beyond Tier 2 are prepared and supported to pursue opportunities within professional cricket.

· Line manage the junior player pathway lead (who will be responsible for the U16 squad and below), setting clear objectives and ensuring high-quality coaching, talent identification and player development throughout the programme.

· Maintain oversight of all age-group programmes and ensure consistency in coaching philosophy, standards, selection and player development across the pathway.

· Lead the identification, tracking and development of talented players and ensure appropriate individual development plans are in place.

· Maintain strong relationships with clubs, schools, partner counties, Tier 1 organisations and other relevant stakeholders to create the best possible development opportunities for Worcestershire players.

· Be accountable for delivery of the Women’s & Girls’ Performance Action Plan and all relevant ECB Minimum Quality Standards.

· Lead and complete the administrative and operational requirements associated with the senior programme and maintain overall oversight of administration across the pathway.

# Fast Track Specialist NDA File Handler

Are you ready to take your litigation skills to the next level? Join our team as a Fast Track Specialist File Handler and make an impact in a challenging, rewarding role.   
   
As a Specialist Handler you will handle litigated delegated and non-delegated motor instructions on behalf of key insurer clients as well as the MIB.

The successful candidate will work in a small team dedicated to dealing with cases involving indemnity issues, on behalf of the MIB and other UK's largest insurers and will report directly to the Team Leader in respect of day-to-day tasks. The team handle cases valued from £0-£150,000 in value.

It will be necessary for the candidate to be able to demonstrate an ability to impress the client with the extent of their legal knowledge as well as their understanding of the litigation process and provide clear unambiguous advice on the strategy for bringing a claim to its resolution. A clear view on both relevant case law and appropriate evidence will be necessary.

The successful candidate should therefore be able to recognise cases with a technical bias, e.g. whether the MIB is the correct party to pursue (having an understanding of the Uninsured Drivers and Untraced Drivers Agreement) or whether an Insurer is a contractual Insurer, RTA Insurer, or Article 75 Insurer, and what actions are required if the policyholder is a Claimant and there is a counterclaim be pursued. The successful candidate should have a good understanding of Part 7 litigation process and dispute resolution. There will also be claims involving multiple parties, as well as progression opportunities to handle more high valued multi-track value claims.

## Key Responsibilities

* Reviewing files, noting and abiding by Client Guidelines
* Knowledge of Part 7 litigation, the CPR Rules and Court procedures
* Formulating initial and ongoing Strategy, efficiently and effectively, having in mind the appropriate fee structure.
* Comply with SLA requirement and critical dates.
* Draft reports confirming Strategy and agreeing the most suitable approach with the client.
* Draft legal documents and comply with Court orders/deadlines
* Throughout the lifetime of a case, being aware of the overall spend on a claim, whether fixed fee or hourly rate.
* Undertaking negotiations with Third Party Solicitors
* Liaising with Insured and Insurers and Brokers where necessary
* Ensuring ‘actions’ are carried out as per Action Lists in Case Management System
* Undertaking Court Hearings
* Ensuring relevant tasks are delegated to the paralegals
* Accurately recording time and management information
* Accurately processing bills in accordance with Client Guidelines
* Ensuring files are kept within ISO 9001 guidelines
* To ensure compliance with the SRA Standards & Regulations

## Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

* Minimum of 18 months experience of handling litigated claims, including Part 7 claims.
* Sound and practical experience of handling Fast Track RTA litigated files is essential, with evidence of managing own case load and reporting skills
* Have an understanding of indemnity and/or the MIB would be beneficial.
* Reporting to, liaising with and meeting clients with a high level of professionalism.
* Drafting of legal documents, including defences, applications, witness statements, Part 35 Questions, Part 18 Questions

* A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* The ability to meet deadlines and work efficiently by managing time in a fast-paced environment.
* A Professional manner with the ability to build relationship internally and externally.
* Recognise when sensitivity and tact are required
* Identify key facts/issues and make early investigations and decisions to bring a case to a conclusion
* Follow work processes and keep to Strategy
* Ability to make decisions
* Assertive and confident to managing expectations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience of managing fixed fees whilst delivering quality
* Good telephone negotiation skills
* Good IT skills including Word, Outlook, and experience of a Case Management System, and preference for working paperless

You’ll win new instructions, build our name in the communities we serve, and make sure every landlord we take on is one we want to keep. We care about how we grow, not just how fast: we would rather lose an instruction than win a problem.

The role will also evolve. As our AI agents take on more of the admin around enquiries and bookings, more of your time goes where it matters: in front of landlords, and out in the community.

###

**Respond fast and convert**

* Make sure every new landlord enquiry gets a rapid, personal response, as speed wins instructions
* Turn enquiries into booked valuations, and valuations into signed landlords
* Follow up every valuation that doesn’t sign, until you have a clear yes or no
* Know where every lead stands, and why any were lost

**Win the instruction**

* Carry out rental valuations that are accurate, well-evidenced and grounded in market data
* Present to a high standard: well prepared, punctual, smartly presented, and clear on what we do and why it’s worth paying for
* Explain our service and the landlord’s obligations with confidence, so landlords know exactly what they’re getting
* Represent the quality of our brand in every interaction, in person and in writing

**Build trust in the community**

* Build a visible, trusted name in the areas we serve, through local relationships and repeatable playbooks rather than one-off campaigns
* Develop long-term relationships with landlords, investors, developers, solicitors, mortgage brokers and sales agents who can refer business
* Stay in touch with landlords who aren’t ready to switch yet, so we’re the first call when they are
* Know your patch: rents, stock, competitors and what local landlords care about

**Grow revenue profitably**

* Work with the Managing Director on unit growth targets and the plan to hit them
* Hold our fees, winning on service and value rather than price
* Keep discounts to the exception, used only where there is a valid reason
* Prioritise landlords and properties that are good long-term business for the branch

**Work alongside our AI agents**

* Use our agentic CRM to manage your pipeline: AI agents handle first responses, reminders and admin, while you own the relationship and the close
* Step in personally wherever a lead needs a human touch
* Share feedback on where the system loses leads, slows responses or gets it wrong

* A track record of winning new business face to face: valuations, sales, business development or similar
* High personal standards: punctual, prepared and professional in how you present yourself and the company
* Confidence to hold a price and sell value rather than discount
* Urgency: you treat every enquiry as revenue and follow up without being chased
* A natural relationship-builder who invests in people over the long term
* Comfortable working alongside AI and automation, and quick to learn new systems
* Full UK driving licence and access to a car

Nice to have:

* Lettings or estate agency valuation experience
* Local knowledge and an existing network in the area
* Experience in a tech-enabled or high-growth business
* Experience managing a pipeline in a CRM

Competitive salary based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our growth.

Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.

Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.
