Sound Engineer & Composer (Working From Home)

**The Company**

We are an award-winning (Cinema Audio Society, Music & Sound, Promax UK, Vox) world class leader in audio services, providing clients with a full offering to deliver any requirement needed in audio advertising, content or production across the globe. 

We’re based in the UK and USA and our 10 studios in Central London are a centre of excellence. We have creative, media, studios and digital under one roof and work on; ADR, music composition, audio branding, sound design and mixing for TV, advertising and film.

Our clients include Spotify (we are their creative partner in the UK & North America), Acast, Netflix, Amazon, Cartoon Network, Disney, Guinness, Paddy Power Betfair and Audible.

We’re a mix of arty, geeky, techy, sporty, creative types who deliver exceptional products for our clients every single day. Diversity and inclusion matter to us and we are committed to inclusion across race, gender, age, religion, identity, physical ability, neurodiversity and experience. We welcome your uniqueness.

In the last few years we’ve also donated time and money to Macmillan Cancer Support, The Malaria Foundation and Crisis, and we intend to do a lot more. We are committed to developing the audio industry and its future talent and we’re an active supporter of initiatives to inspire, train and develop young talent and open our doors to bring a diverse group of people into our industry. 

We’re big on culture, teamwork and growth opportunities, and we’ve got exciting plans for the future which we’d love you to be part of. 

**Our Culture - Defined By Our Team**

We're creative (standard). We're honest and open. A swear jar would bankrupt a lot of us. We're all equal and we laugh at ourselves... and each other. 

We're unconventional, productive and we do whatever it takes to get the job done. We like burgers (meat, veggie and vegan). 

We always make time for each other and our clients. We live and breathe audio. We're people pleasers. We're all very different and we love that about our team. 

We praise each other and recognise achievements. We like going to the pub for alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. We don't quit, we fix. We're kind and caring. We make a difference. We stick together and pick each other up when it's needed.

We like to dance. We say please and thank you. We're passionate and motivated. We always leave our clients feeling good.

**Key Responsibilities**

Day to day you will:

* Engineer audio sessions from a home setup.
* Create original music and songs - from composition and production through to mixing and mastering.
* Create sound design, edit dialogue and create final mixes.
* Use Source Connect and Cleanfeed to record voice overs and monitor remotely.
* Deliver files to the team and to clients.
* Share tips and tricks with other engineers - no matter how long we’ve been doing this, we’re always learning!
* We run an engineer mentorship programme in the business, so a willingness to support more junior members of the team will be important.
* Attend occasional out of hours meetings and events, including a monthly engineer team meeting (online).

**Essential Requirements**

* At least 3 years experience of composing, recording and programming music for audio and visual content.
* Full confidence with recording voiceover, including with multiple voices, plus tracklaying, sound design, editing audio, internal bouncing and creating stem files (M&Es etc) as requested.
* Experience of songwriting and toplines.
* Experience of directing vocal recording sessions.
* An understanding of song structure and musical terminology.
* An exceptional ear for detail and quality. You will always recognise when something sounds good and when it doesn't.
* An extensive, confident knowledge of ProTools.
* Good working knowledge of Izotope RX, Source Connect, Cleanfeed and other related audio software.

**Qualifications and experience**

* A thorough knowledge of ProTools is a must – including knowledge of EQ, Compression, searching for sounds, and how to treat voice files. You will be tested on this as part of the latter interview stages.
* Familiarity with other software has been mentioned throughout this doc - the list is not exhaustive.
* You could be someone who's worked as a freelancer or in house at another Post House, but you must have several years of client project experience.
* A degree is not a prerequisite.
* Attention to detail is key and being organised is paramount.
* Great communication skills, with good email and phone-manner are important.

**Bonus Points**

* Fluency in other languages
* Experience of working on content for cartoons and content for children
* Experience of writing lyrics
* A knowledge of surround mixing would be beneficial

**Working Hours**

This role is a full time role, 5 days a week, 9-6pm with flexibility for early starts and evening work where required.

**Location & working arrangements**

This role will be home-based.

You can be based anywhere in the UK. However being in the south-east may be of benefit as you could attend meetings or studio sessions in London from time to time, however this is not mandatory.

**Home-working setup**

As the role is largely remote, you should:

* Have access to a quiet, suitable working environment where you can work confidently on both speakers and headphones.
* Have the ability to record instruments and guide tracks with your own voice.
* Have a reliable, high-speed internet connection suitable for transferring large audio files and collaborating remotely.
* Ideally have a Mac-based home setup with a suitable audio interface and monitoring. However, we can help arrange or provide the necessary equipment if required.

**Salary And Benefits (UK)**

* Competitive salary, in-line with your skills and experience.
* 25 days holiday plus standard bank holidays for England, and 3 extra days between Christmas and New Year when the business is closed (total of 28 days plus public holidays).
* Subsidised Bupa medical care.
* Life Insurance.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* Various training schemes to help us all be better.
* Season ticket loan scheme.
* Eye Care scheme with Specsavers.
* Help@Hand from Unum (a health and wellbeing app).

It’s really important that we are a right fit for each other. Therefore we usually have three chats; phone, online and in person. This is so we can get to know each other properly which is really important for you and us, as we want you to be with us for a long time so you need to know it’s right for you too.

If there is another way you’d like to do this, that will really give you the chance to shine, please tell us if we get in touch to chat. 

**Apply**

Please apply with your CV, portfolio link and a cover letter and tell us why you’d like to join us and how you’d add brilliance to our team, to careers@foreveraudio.com with the subject header **“SE&C - 2026”.**

# Quality Manager- Manufacturing Operations

Bristol

## **About Fractile**

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

**About the role**

Based in the UK you will be a key member of the Manufacturing Operations team where you will drive the development of our business management systems as well as our product, supplier, software and customer quality initiatives.

You will be comfortable with assessing processes and technologies to identify quality gaps and provide robust but pragmatic solutions to drive all aspects of the business in achieving the highest levels of quality and resilience.

**Key responsibilities**

* Define and deliver the company quality strategy, policy and objectives, aligned to the product roadmap and growth plan.
* Build, lead and develop a quality team covering supplier, product, reliability, software and systems quality.
* Define and report quality performance to the executive team.
* Establish appropriate document control, change control, CAPA, internal audit, training and records processes that scale with a fast-growing fabless company.
* Work with PMO to embed quality gates into the new product introduction (NPI) and product lifecycle process, from concept through end of life.
* Own quality across the supply chain: wafer foundry, assembly and packaging, wafer and final test, PCB/PCBA and system-level contract manufacturers.

# Senior Site Reliability Engineer

### **About the role**

SteelEye, now merged with FundApps, provides communications, trade and order surveillance to some of the world's largest financial institutions. Clients run on shared or dedicated infrastructure depending on what they need, which means we operate a large estate of clusters, data pipelines and client environments for the size of our engineering team.

This role keeps that estate healthy. Not just up, but doing its job: client data arriving completely, surveillance running against the right window, the alerts our clients depend on actually firing. When something is wrong we want to know before they do.

It is a hands-on engineering role. You will spend your time in Terraform, Kubernetes manifests and code rather than in meetings about them.

### **What you'll be working on**

**Running the Kubernetes estate.** We run many client environments across EKS. You will keep them properly separated, sensibly sized and able to scale when a client sends us more data than we expected. Isolation between clients is a client assurance commitment, not just good practice, so the boundaries matter.

**Knowing what is happening.** We have a substantial monitoring and alerting setup and it needs to keep pace with the platform. You will extend it, keep the signal useful, and push ownership of alerts and service levels out to the teams that build the services rather than holding it all centrally.

**Making deployment boring.** Changes should reach production frequently, in small pieces, without drama. You will keep our pipelines fast and our deployments predictable, and make it easy for engineers to ship safely without needing to understand how any of it works underneath.

**Making things fail gracefully.** You will work with the engineers building our services on how the platform behaves when something is slow, something is down, or a message cannot be processed. Retries, resource limits, queue handling and recovery, designed in rather than discovered during an incident.

**Keeping the cost sensible.** Our hosting cost grows as we add clients. You will work on right sizing, compute efficiency and understanding what each client environment actually costs us.

**Incidents.** You can volunteer to join a compensated, out of hours rota shared across the team, and take part in making sure the same incident does not happen twice.

## What success looks like

* Engineers can answer normal operational questions without needing production access.
* We find out about problems from our monitoring rather than from a client.
* Deploying is routine enough that nobody plans their week around it.
* Adding a new client is routine and automated.
* Cost per client environment is understood and trending the right way.
* Nothing in the estate depends on one person knowing how it works, including you

## What you'll bring

* You have run production infrastructure on AWS for several years and know it properly: EKS, IAM and networking in particular, across multiple accounts and regions.
* You are strong with Kubernetes beyond the basics. Multi tenancy, Helm, scaling behaviour, and what actually happens when a cluster is under pressure.
* You write Terraform that other people can safely change, and you treat infrastructure code with the same standards as application code.
* You write code. Python, Go, or something comparable. Enough to automate properly, build the small services and controllers that fill the gaps, and read the applications you are supporting.
* You have built or run CI/CD properly, and have worked with GitOps as a way of managing what is deployed.
* You have operated data heavy systems. Message queues, search clusters, pipelines that move a lot and cannot quietly lose anything.
* You treat an incident as something to learn from rather than something to survive.
* You work well with the engineers building the product. Much of this role is making other teams faster and safer, which means being someone they come to early rather than after something has gone wrong.

**Our estate, for context**

* AWS and Azure · Kubernetes and EKS · Karpenter · Terraform · Helm · FluxCD · GitHub Actions · Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and OpenTelemetry · Kafka · Elasticsearch · PostgreSQL · ClickHouse · Python and Go services ·
* You do not need to have used all of it. You should recognise most of it and be genuinely deep in some of it.

**How you work**

* You prefer automated guardrails to manual approvals and paved paths to documentation. You would rather fix the cause than add a runbook entry.

You are pragmatic about what is worth automating and what is worth leaving alone, and you can tell the difference under time pressure.

# Solution Architect (we have office locations in Cambridge, Leeds and London)

* Full-time
* Department: Technology & Architecture

## Company Description

Genomics England is a global leader in enabling genomic medicine and research, focused on creating a world where everyone benefits from genomic healthcare. Building on the 100,000 Genomes Project, we support the NHS’s world-first national whole genome sequencing service and run the growing National Genomic Research Library, alongside delivering numerous major genomics initiatives. By connecting research and clinical care at national scale, we enable immediate healthcare benefits and advances for the future.

Our mission is to provide the evidence and digital systems so that by 2035 genomics could play a role in up to half of all healthcare interactions, whilst securing the UK’s position as the best place to discover, prove and benefit from genomic innovations.

We are accelerating our impact and working with patients, doctors, scientists, government and industry to improve genomic testing, and help researchers access the health data and technology they need to make new medical discoveries and create more effective, targeted medicines for everybody.

Behind the Healthcare and Research outcomes, Genomics England delivers through designing, developing and operating complex healthcare software systems.

We're on the cusp of big changes with the real prospect of genomics becoming the fabric of everyday healthcare through the lifetime - from birth to old age.

## Job Description

**Solution Architect**

We’re looking for an accomplished Solution Architect to join our Use Research Data team at Genomics England.

Our Use Research Data service (URD) helps researchers securely access and use genomic and associated health data, supporting research that can improve our understanding of disease and lead to better treatments and healthcare outcomes.

Working within the Technology and Product Directorate, you’ll help shape and deliver the platforms, data services and technical capabilities that underpin this work. You’ll collaborate with engineering, product, science, data, security and delivery colleagues to turn complex research and user needs into coherent, scalable and secure solutions.

This is a hands-on architecture role where you’ll balance longer-term technical direction with practical delivery. You’ll guide teams through architectural decisions, develop reusable patterns and ensure solutions align with Genomics England’s wider technology strategy, architecture standards and security requirements.

The complex nature of genomics research means we use a broad range of technologies, with AWS at the heart of our environment, supporting data ingestion and processing, workflow execution, high-performance compute, high-speed storage, advanced security, and genomics-specific capabilities on AWS.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture and design of solutions within the Use Research Data service, ensuring they are secure, scalable, resilient and aligned with research and user needs.
* Design solutions across application, data, infrastructure, integration and security domains.
* Work with product managers, engineers, scientists, data specialists, security colleagues and delivery teams to understand problems, clarify requirements and develop effective solution options.
* Shape technical roadmaps and help teams balance immediate delivery priorities with longer-term architectural direction.
* Architect solutions that support the secure storage, processing, analysis and use of large-scale genomic and associated health data.
* Apply proven experience designing solutions across complex AWS environments, including compute, storage, networking, identity, access management, security and integration.
* Support research capabilities involving data ingestion, workflow execution, high-performance compute, high-speed storage and trusted access to sensitive data.
* Develop reusable architecture patterns that improve consistency, interoperability, maintainability and delivery across research products and services.
* Ensure solutions are secure by design and meet relevant data governance, privacy, regulatory and operational requirements.
* Document architectures, technical options, decisions, dependencies and transition states clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Provide architectural oversight throughout the lifecycle, from early discovery and technical evaluation through to implementation and live service.
* Contribute to architecture governance and assurance, including presenting designs and recommendations through appropriate technical forums.
* Identify technical risks, constraints and dependencies early, working collaboratively with teams to address them.
* Evaluate emerging AWS services and other technologies where they could improve the performance, scalability, security or cost-effectiveness of our research platforms.
* Work with architects across Genomics England to create coherent end-to-end solutions and encourage appropriate reuse across services.
* Contribute to architecture best practice and improving the quality of architecture across Genomics England.

**Skills and Experience for Success**

* Substantial experience designing and delivering AWS solution architectures in complex, data-intensive environments, with strong knowledge across services relating to compute, storage, networking, identity, security, data processing and integration.
* Experience architecting for the whole context, designing architectures across application, data, infrastructure and security domains.
* Experience designing secure, scalable and resilient platforms that process, store or provide controlled access to large and complex datasets.
* Strong understanding of architecture patterns and principles for cloud and hybrid environments.
* Experience translating complex business, research or user needs into practical technical designs and delivery roadmaps.
* Proven ability to balance strategic architectural direction with immediate delivery needs and constraints.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and building alignment between engineering, product, data, security, delivery and domain stakeholders.
* Good understanding of secure-by-design principles, data protection, governance and access controls when working with sensitive data.
* Experience documenting and communicating architectures, options, risks and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience providing architectural governance and assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Good understanding of integration patterns, APIs and interoperability across complex services and platforms.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills and a collaborative approach that builds trust and supports effective decision-making.
* Demonstrable experience using innovative technology such as AI.
* Ability to recognise where architecture practices could be improved, proactively suggest improvements and deliver these into regular usage.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**

* AWS architecture certification or another relevant professional certification.
* Experience working with data-intensive research, scientific, healthcare, genomics or other regulated platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in genomics, bioinformatics or a related field; or extensive equivalent experience.
* Knowledge of AWS services supporting genomics or large-scale research workloads, such as AWS HealthOmics.
* Experience with high-performance compute, large-scale or high-speed storage, workflow orchestration or distributed data-processing environments.
* Knowledge of research workflows and the lifecycle of data, from ingestion and processing through to secure access, analysis and reuse.
* Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automation and observability.
* Understanding of metadata, data lineage, data products and interoperability standards.
* Knowledge of relevant genomics or research standards and technologies, such as OMOP, GA4GH, FHIR, Common Workflow Language, Nextflow or WDL.
* Experience contributing to architecture governance forums such as a Technical Design Authority.
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as Abacus.
* Experience applying TOGAF or equivalent architecture practices.

If you’re an experienced Solution Architect with proven AWS expertise, who enjoys working on complex technology and data challenges, this is a fantastic opportunity to help shape resilient platforms that enable secure, responsible and impactful genomic research at Genomics England.

# Infrastructure Engineer (ML Compute) - London

## Location

Hybrid London; Hybrid Paris

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Hybrid

## Department

Engineering

OverviewApplication

You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.

This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

## What success looks like

Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

## What you’ll be doing

* Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference
* Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed
* Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes
* Managing capacity with our cloud providers
* Debugging failures in GPUs, Linux, storage and networking

## The first year

By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

## Who you’ll work with

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

## What we think it takes

**You’re likely a good fit if you:**

* Have built and run GPU workloads on Kubernetes
* Could design a GPU cluster for training and online RL from scratch
* Debug confidently at the OS layer and below (Linux, GPU drivers, networking and storage)
* Write strong Python

**It’s a plus if you’ve worked as an SRE or infrastructure engineer, or have used:**

* Slurm
* Kubernetes scheduling and autoscaling tools such as Kueue or Karpenter
* Multi-cloud orchestration tools such as SkyPilot
* AWS services such as EKS or SageMaker HyperPod
* High-performance interconnects and collective communication libraries such as EFA, InfiniBand, NCCL or Open MPI
* Terraform

You don’t need ML research experience. If you match most of this but not every point, please apply.

## How we hire

Four stages, about three hours in total: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering. The coding and system design interviews are modelled on real-world problems you’d face in this role.

## Practicalities

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office and occasional travel between the two. We offer a competitive package.

# Data Migration and Integration Consultant (HR/Payroll Systems)

UK - Remote

Harbor is looking for a **Data Migration and Integration Consultant** to join our HR and payroll transformation practice. This is a technical consulting role at the heart of our delivery work, responsible for moving client data safely and accurately into modern HR platforms and for designing and building the integrations that keep those platforms connected to the wider technology landscape.

You will work across engagements involving SAP SuccessFactors, Workday and Oracle HCM, taking clients from messy, fragmented legacy data through to clean, validated go live loads, and from integration requirements through to tested, supportable interfaces. The role suits someone who enjoys the detail of data work but can also explain it clearly to HR and business stakeholders who do not speak in file formats.

This is a remote position based in the UK, with travel to client sites as needed.

---

#### What you will do:

**Data migration**

* Lead and deliver data migration workstreams into SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or Oracle HCM, from strategy and planning through to go live and hypercare
* Define migration approaches, including scoping of data objects, load sequencing, cutover plans and rollback positions
* Profile and assess legacy data quality, identifying gaps, duplicates and inconsistencies, and agreeing cleansing ownership with the client
* Design and maintain mapping and transformation rules between legacy sources and target system structures
* Build, execute and reconcile data loads across multiple test cycles, mock conversions and production cutover
* Produce validation and reconciliation reporting that gives clients confidence in the accuracy and completeness of migrated data
* Advise clients on data retention, archiving and the treatment of historical records

**Integration design and delivery**

* Gather and document integration requirements across HR, payroll, benefits, finance and third party providers
* Produce integration designs and specifications covering data flows, transformation logic, error handling, scheduling and security
* Build, test and deploy integrations using platform native tooling and middleware
* Support end to end and payroll parallel testing, resolving defects across connected systems
* Define monitoring, error resolution and support processes so that integrations are sustainable after go live
* Advise clients on integration architecture, including the trade offs between point to point connections, middleware and file based approaches

**ETL and data engineering**

* Use ETL tooling to extract, transform and load data at scale across migration and integration workstreams
* Develop repeatable, auditable transformation routines rather than one off manual manipulation
* Automate validation and reconciliation checks where practical to reduce cycle times and manual effort
* Contribute to the development of practice accelerators, templates and reusable migration assets

**Client and practice contribution**

* Act as the trusted technical voice on engagements, translating data and integration matters into plain language for HR and programme stakeholders
* Support proposals, scoping and estimating for migration and integration workstreams
* Coach junior consultants and share technical knowledge across the team

#### What we are looking for:

**Essential**

* Proven data migration experience into at least one of SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or Oracle HCM, across multiple full lifecycle projects
* Integration design and technical delivery experience, including producing specifications and building and testing interfaces
* Hands on experience with ETL tooling and confidence manipulating large, imperfect datasets
* Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, including the sensitivities around personal data and the importance of accuracy at cutover
* Experience running reconciliation and validation across test cycles and production loads
* Clear communicator, able to work with both technical teams and HR stakeholders
* Right to work in the UK and willingness to travel to client sites when needed

**Desirable**

* Experience across more than one of the three target platforms
* Knowledge of platform specific tooling such as Workday EIB, Core Connectors and Studio, SAP Integration Suite and Infoporter, or Oracle HDL and OIC
* Experience with payroll migrations and parallel run reconciliation
* Familiarity with UK GDPR and the data protection considerations that apply to migration and integration work
* Exposure to professional services or legal sector clients
* Consulting experience, or client-side experience with a clear consulting mindset

#### What you can expect:

* Varied technical work across three major HR platforms, rather than being tied to a single technology
* A collaborative practice with direct access to senior leadership and genuine input into how we grow
* Investment in platform certifications and wider professional development
* Competitive salary, bonus and benefits, with flexible and remote working supported

* Partner with Data and Analytics to turn ambiguous questions into insight that changes product decisions
* Align product, design, data, and engineering on clinical tradeoffs and keep decisions moving

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

## **What the Project Is About**

Data centres are becoming some of Europe's most consequential and fastest-growing electricity users, yet most still appear to the grid as large, opaque, and largely grid-agnostic loads. AIRCAS, short for **AI-driven Resource & Cooling forCASting and control for data centres**, gives you the opportunity to change this through advanced AI control in a live data-centre environment. You will help build a digital twin, forecasting, and safety-constrained control system that coordinates electricity demand, cooling, heat recovery, and water use.

At HPE Labs Ireland, the role will involve live telemetry processing, research, training, evaluation, and deployment of reinforcement-learning controllers across two MODPODs in the Customer Innovation Centre (CIC) data centre. You will validate control policies through replay, hardware-in-the-loop, shadow-mode, and controlled live trials. This is an applied research role spanning physical-system modelling, software engineering, machine learning, and operational deployment.

You will collaborate with our international project partners: the University of Porto, CNRS, Savery Tech, RWTH Aachen, Swerim, TerraBarrier, and Daikin Applied.

  

## **The Opportunity**

Hewlett Packard Labs is seeking a highly qualified, self-motivated machine-learning and AI researcher to join its growing AI research team in Ireland. The role will accelerate research on digital twins that incorporate machine learning, with a focus on the AIRCAS programme.

You will develop and deploy advanced reinforcement-learning control for a live data-centre environment. The work spans research, software engineering, and experimental validation: from data collection and physical-system modelling through forecasting, control-policy training, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow operation, and bounded live trials.

## **What You Will Do**

* Build the CIC data and workload pipeline, including controlled workload generation, telemetry ingestion, time-series data management, data-quality checks, and baseline datasets.
* Develop modular digital-twin software that combines site telemetry with physical models, empirical performance maps, cooling and storage models, and operational constraints.
* Develop probabilistic forecasts for IT load, cooling demand, and relevant water and heat signals using CIC operational data.
* Research, implement, train, and evaluate objective-shifting multi-objective reinforcement-learning policies that balance flexibility, cost, carbon, water use, and durability within hard safety limits.
* Implement a price-response interface that produces feasible, auditable flexibility commitments with uncertainty information.
* Validate the control stack through replay, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow mode, and controlled actuation windows on the CIC MODPODs.
* Produce reproducible evidence for flexibility, reliability, sustainability, and durability performance, including measurement-and-verification workflows and KPI analysis.
* Collaborate with HPE Labs researchers and the AIRCAS partners to integrate laboratory cooling results, sustainability signals, and physical operating guardrails into the control system.

  

## **About Hewlett Packard Labs and AIRL**

Hewlett Packard Labs is HPE's central research organisation. Its purpose is to deliver breakthrough technologies that create a competitive advantage for HPE, investing in fundamental areas of strategic interest and preparing resulting technologies for adoption.

The AI Research Lab (AIRL) focuses on applied machine-learning research and applications relevant to HPE and its customers. Its work includes reinforcement learning for sustainability, digital twins, complex scientific applications such as fusion energy, large language models, trustworthy and responsible AI, and data foundations for AI. The team brings together diverse skills and expertise to explore ambitious research and technology opportunities.

  

## **What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a machine-learning research engineer with experience in machine learning, time-series analysis, reinforcement learning, and digital twins. The role requires strong engineering judgement and an aptitude for modelling physical systems. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, comfortable with system-level analysis and design, and motivated to turn research ideas into deployed technology.

We expect team members to provide technical leadership, take innovative ideas from conception through design, development, implementation, evaluation, and technology transfer, and collaborate effectively with HPE Labs teams, external partners, and HPE's wider innovation community.

  

## **Education and Experience**

* PhD degree, or Master's degree with equivalent research and innovation experience, in a relevant discipline such as computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or mechanical engineering.
* Proven record of innovation in deep learning, scientific computing, engineering computation, or machine-learning applications.
* Demonstrated experience developing proofs of concept, first-of-a-kind solutions, or technologies for transfer into practice.
* Evidence of independent research leadership, for example through publications in leading conferences or journals.

  
  

## **Required Technical Skills**

* Strong software-development skills in Python and PyTorch.
* Strong experience applying machine learning to physical systems.
* Knowledge of digital twins, machine learning with digital twins, and sustainability applications.
* Strong science or engineering background, including system-level analysis and modelling.

* Ability to develop integrated software algorithms; work with large-scale computing, data-analysis, and modelling environments; and translate technical specifications into robust code.
* Excellent research, development, written, and verbal communication skills in English.

  

## **Preferred Skills**

We’re looking for a **Product Commercial Manager** to join our Pricing & Product Operations team and help strengthen how we understand, demonstrate and measure the commercial value of our products.

You’ll work across Product, Pricing and go-to-market teams to ensure product investment decisions are grounded in clear evidence of customer value and demand, helping us understand not just what we should build, but why it matters commercially and how we know it has delivered.

You’ll develop a consistent approach to value cases, support product teams in applying it and use customer, product and commercial data to understand the value our products create. A key part of the role will be using AI and automation to make this approach scalable, building repeatable tools and workflows that product teams can ultimately use themselves.

* Develop and own a consistent approach for assessing the customer and commercial value behind product investments.
* Partner with product teams to build evidence-based value cases and provide clear commercial recommendations on significant investments.
* Quantify the value our products deliver and help translate this into compelling propositions, pricing and commercial decisions.
* Define how value should be measured before launch and track performance against expected adoption, demand, pricing and revenue outcomes.
* Analyse customer usage and behaviour to understand realised value and inform customer segmentation, pricing and renewal strategies.
* Provide recommendations on whether to continue, scale, change or retire products and initiatives.
* Support major pricing reviews and new product launches alongside the Senior Pricing Director.
* Build AI-enabled tools and repeatable workflows that make value analysis scalable across the Product organisation.
* Turn complex data and analysis into clear commercial recommendations for Product, go-to-market and senior stakeholders.

We’re looking for someone with a strong **commercial analysis background** who enjoys using data to understand performance, challenge assumptions and support better business decisions.

* Experience in a commercial analysis, commercial finance, pricing, strategy or similar analytical role.
* Strong experience building commercial models, business cases and data-led recommendations.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with incomplete or complex data to reach a clear conclusion.

* **Growth:** Continuous learning and career development opportunities.

## About this role

You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed that **you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it**. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

## Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

[REDACTED] is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like [REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED], who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us **take online education to new heights** and **make a meaningful impact on humankind**.

At [REDACTED], we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

## We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

* **Our Course Writers and Editors:** lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective. **This is the role described here.**
* **Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:** lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.
* **Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:** lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

**You, the Course Writer and Editor**, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. Our **Education Designers** hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with our **Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors**, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

## Your Role at [REDACTED]

* **Be a core part of our Editorial Team.** You'll collaborate with [REDACTED] editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to **create educational content for people worldwide**. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills in **timeless, human-centered design and AI**.
* **Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.** The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.
* **You don't need a design background.** Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.
* **Write for a diverse, global audience.** Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.
* **Be the voice of [REDACTED].** Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours. **Represent a global movement dedicated to design education**, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.
* **Set and raise the standard for our assessments**, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.
* **Balance the big picture with the smaller details.** Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.
* **Turn expert material into lessons.** Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.
* Our courses **combine written and video lessons.** You'll work closely with the video team, giving **constructive feedback** on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

Front-end engineering and product delivery
Design, build and improve applications using React and TypeScript.

Improve front-end performance, reliability and the user experience.
Work across the software development lifecycle, from shaping requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, release and iteration.

Build and maintain a shared component library so the platform looks and behaves consistently across modules.
Design integrations with payment, CRM and accounting platforms so they can be reused from one client to the next.
Quality, reliability and security
Review code, encourage good engineering practices and maintain a high standard of quality.
Build automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline so releases are routine and low risk.
Help keep the platform available to the agreed service level and lead the technical response to front-end and application incidents.
Write up incidents afterwards, without blame, and follow through on the fixes.
Apply secure coding practice to all work, with particular care around authentication, payments and personal data.
Keep each client’s data separate and test that separation as part of every release.
Provide technical evidence for the company’s data protection and information security work, including GDPR and ISO 27001.
Client implementation and support
Support the technical side of new client implementations, including configuration, integrations and data migration.
Act as the technical escalation point for issues the help desk cannot resolve.
Spend time with LUMYA Living site teams to see how the platform is used day to day and bring what you learn back into the product.
Engineering practice and team development
Share knowledge, provide technical guidance and mentor other developers.
Keep documentation for each core module current, so no part of the platform depends on one person.

Experience mentoring or guiding other developers.

**About Marex**

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets.

The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

For more information visit https://www.marex.com/

Vacancy Number: VN3247

**Department description**

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights and analytics.

The Technology Department delivers differentiation, scalability and security for the business. Technology provides digital tools, software services and infrastructure globally to all business groups. Software development and support teams work in agile ‘streams’ aligned to specific business areas. Our other teams work enterprise-wide to provide critical services including our global service desk, network and system infrastructure, IT operations, security, enterprise architecture and design.

The Data & AI team drives productivity, compliance, and insights through a robust Data Lakehouse, decentralized data access and data-driven practices. Within this, the AI function is scaling Marex's AI capability through a federated model that gives business units the freedom to build their own AI solutions, underpinned by an evolving governance framework. The Head of AI Governance & Operations sits within this team, reporting to the Head of Data & AI, and provides the operational and governance backbone that allows the federated model to scale safely.

**Role Summary**

Marex is seeking a senior, operationally minded AI leader to serve as Head of AI Governance & Operations - acting as a hands-on operator with deep AI governance and regulatory expertise, embedding this into Marex's existing governance, risk and vendor management processes, and freeing the Head of Data & AI to focus on strategic priorities by owning day-to-day AI coordination.

You will own and evolve Marex's AI Governance framework, keeping pace with an evolving regulatory environment (including the EU AI Act) across the jurisdictions in which Marex operates. You will act as the firm's AI Governance SME, embedding AI-specific expertise into Marex's existing governance, risk and compliance processes rather than building parallel structures. You will run the AI Working Group in partnership with the AI Engineering Manager and provide governance input to the AI Steering Group chaired by the Head of Data & AI.

You will horizon-scan developments from Marex's AI vendors and partners (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS), getting ahead of new model and feature releases so that Marex can make deliberate, well-governed decisions about adoption, and track AI cost (e.g. token consumption) to give the business visibility into usage. You will coordinate the trial and rollout of new AI products and capabilities (e.g. Claude Cowork), working with Marex's existing Infrastructure, Network, End User Computing and Information Security teams to move safely from pilot cohort to scaled deployment.

**Responsibilities**

***Role specific:***

* Own and evolve Marex's AI Governance policy and framework, keeping pace with evolving regulatory expectations (e.g. the EU AI Act) across the jurisdictions in which Marex operates, and translating policy into practical, adopted controls.
* Act as the firm's AI Governance SME, embedding AI-specific expertise into Marex's existing governance, risk and compliance processes, and providing hands-on guidance to business units and engineering teams on responsible, compliant AI use.
* Run the AI Working Group, partnering closely with the AI Engineering Manager, and provide structured papers and input to the AI Steering Group chaired by the Head of Data & AI.
* Horizon-scan developments from Marex's AI vendors and partners (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS), proactively identifying new models, features and capabilities, and coordinating with relevant teams to prepare for, gate, or delay adoption as appropriate.
* Coordinate the trial and rollout of new AI products and capabilities (e.g. Claude Cowork), working with Marex's existing Infrastructure, Network, End User Computing and Information Security teams - who retain ownership of their respective execution - to move from pilot cohort to safe, scaled deployment.
* Embed Responsible AI practices throughout the AI lifecycle, ensuring ethical, transparent and accountable development and deployment across the federated AI operating model.
* Ensure AI use cases and associated risks are captured within Marex's existing governance processes, bringing AI governance expertise to risk assessment and sign-off ahead of deployment.
* Track AI cost (e.g. token consumption) to provide visibility to the AI Steering Group and stakeholders.
* Provide AI governance and market input to support Procurement-led vendor negotiations, contract renewals and annual commits with AI platform and model vendors (e.g. AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI); final decisions on commercial offers rest with the AI Steering Group.
* Ensure AI-specific incidents and risks are captured within Marex's existing incident and risk management processes, and that lessons learned feed back into the AI governance framework.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Information Security and Data Privacy to ensure AI governance controls are integrated with, and not duplicative of, existing regulatory frameworks (e.g. MiFID II, DORA, GDPR).
* Provide governance and operational input to support the Head of Data & AI's Steering Group and Board/exco reporting on AI.

***All staff:***

* Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS.
* Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
* Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
* At all times complying with the FCA’s Code of Conduct
* To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
* To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
* To escalate risk events immediately
* To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

***Competencies, Skills, Experience & Qualifications:***

**Skills and Experience:**

**Essential:**

* Leadership experience in technology, data, risk or governance functions, including meaningful experience operating in or around AI specifically.
* Financial Services experience, with a solid understanding of the regulatory, risk and commercial context in which Marex operates.
* Deep, current understanding of the fast-moving AI landscape - technologies, vendors and regulatory developments - with the ability to translate this into practical governance and operational decisions.
* Expert in AI governance, with experience establishing and scaling Responsible AI practices in enterprise/regulated environments, and hands-on familiarity with emerging global AI regulation (e.g. the EU AI Act).
* Familiarity with AWS Bedrock's governance and guardrail capabilities, alongside experience of token cost management.
* Commercial awareness, with experience contributing AI governance expertise into vendor negotiations and contract discussions led by others (e.g. Procurement).
* Experience embedding domain-specific expertise into existing governance, risk or incident management processes, rather than building and running standalone structures.

Medtronic Neuromodulation has pioneered life-changing therapies for 50 years, helping patients with movement disorders and chronic pain. From spinal cord stimulation and deep brain stimulation to implantable drug delivery systems, we continue to advance technologies that restore patient freedom. Our vision is to become the undisputed world leader in Neuromodulation, improving patient lives through innovative solutions.  
  
The Senior Materials R&D Engineer will provide materials expertise within the Galway Interventional R&D team, with technical ownership of the bone cement materials portfolio.  
  
Collaborating with global colleagues, suppliers and partners to develop and optimise medical device materials and processes. The role spans early investigation through verification, validation and commercialisation, alongside support for existing products. You will guide materials selection, characterisation and testing, resolve complex technical challenges and mentor colleagues to deliver safe, reliable products that support our vision. Expertise in bone cement formulation, processing and performance evaluation would be an advantage.  
Come for a job, stay for a career!

Within Medtronic’s Neuromodulation R&D organisation, you will work with teams developing and testing products for the Pain Interventions business. The team develops innovative, minimally invasive therapies for musculoskeletal conditions, including vertebral compression fractures, nerve pain, and metastatic and benign bone tumours. The role may be based in Galway, Ireland or Minneapolis, Minnesota, and will work with colleagues across sites.

  

As a Senior Materials R&D Engineer, you will provide materials science and engineering expertise to new product development and released product reliability teams. Your work will include materials selection and problem-solving, with a focus on areas such as balloon catheter design, bone cement optimisation and polymer component design.

  

You will contribute technical leadership in materials processing, characterisation and analysis, and help teams understand how material properties and processing affect product performance. You will also support material stability, biocompatibility and biostability assessments; identify and help mitigate product-related risks; and communicate technical issues, resource gaps and recommendations to project and functional leaders.

  

Working with cross-functional teams, you will help shape product strategies, identify technologies and initiatives needed to develop innovative, reliable and cost-effective therapies, and develop and execute plans to address those needs.

You will also contribute to intellectual property generation:

  

* Contribute to the development of products used in medical procedures, aligned with business needs and patient requirements.

* Address complex materials challenges across early-phase product development projects, using sound engineering judgement and materials science expertise.

* Apply materials science principles to develop and evaluate polymer and composite material solutions, including associated manufacturing, fabrication and assembly processes.

* Provide materials expertise to new product development teams and support sustaining engineering activities for commercial products.

* Take technical ownership of the bone cement materials portfolio, supporting development, material characterisation, performance evaluation and sustaining activities. Previous bone cement expertise would be an advantage

* Lead the development of product and process requirements, with particular focus on material specifications.

* Establish effective, reliable and cost-conscious material processing methods for manufacturing.

* Provide technical support for clinical programmes, field-related activities and complaint investigations.

* Lead design and technical reviews with cross-functional partners, suppliers and other stakeholders.

* Develop strategies and evaluation plans to address gaps in materials, design and processes, balancing timelines, cost, technical requirements, patient safety and product reliability.

* Participate in sourcing, testing and approval of materials.

* Set technical expectations for supplier and vendor deliverables, review their work and provide direction as needed.

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.

* Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Chemistry, Polymer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with at least seven years of relevant experience; or a master’s degree with at least 4 years of relevant experience; or a PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience

* Developing, analysing or specifying materials and related processing or fabrication methods

* Material characterisation, laboratory testing, test method development and interpretation of technical data.

* Knowledge of material properties, design requirements, processing controls and quality specifications

* Medical device development or another regulated industry is preferred.

* Polymers, biomaterials, bone cement or other materials used in implantable or interventional devices is an advantage.

* Familiarity with design controls, risk management, material equivalency, failure analysis or supplier process reviews is beneficial.

* Knowledge of design of experiments, statistical methods, Six Sigma or design for manufacture.

* Ability to work independently on complex technical problems, manage project deliverables and influence decisions through clear technical communication.

* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across functions, sites and organisational boundaries.

Autodesk Research – Intelligent Construction

Summer 2027 | 12 weeks

  

**Position Overview**

Modern AI systems increasingly depend on their ability to access and use the right context at

the right time. An important research challenge is how large, evolving bodies of information

should be represented to support reliable inference.

Autodesk Research provides a distinctive setting for this work. Construction projects are rich,

complex information environments whose state changes continuously over time, making

them a compelling domain for studying context and knowledge systems for AI.

As a Research Intern, you will own a focused research problem in this area. You will

investigate new approaches to building and retrieving structured context, develop

experimental prototypes, and evaluate how effectively they support downstream AI

reasoning.

You will work closely with Autodesk researchers and engineers and have substantial freedom

to bring ideas from your own research. Strong contributions may form the basis of an

academic publication and future Autodesk research.

  

**Responsibilities**

• Conduct original research in context and knowledge systems for AI. Investigate

methods for representing and retrieving information to support reliable contextual

inference

• Develop new approaches to context construction. Explore how relevant knowledge

can be identified and assembled dynamically from large and evolving information

environments

• Build research prototypes. Implement experimental systems using graph-based,

semantic or hybrid approaches and apply them to realistic project information

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments. Develop suitable research questions,

baselines and evaluation methods to understand the strengths and limitations of

proposed approaches

• Collaborate with Autodesk researchers and engineers. Work across AI research,

software engineering and domain expertise to refine ideas and translate them into

experimental systems

• Communicate research findings. Present results within Autodesk Research and

contribute, where appropriate, to research papers, technical reports and

demonstrations

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Data Science, Information Science or a closely related field, with at least one

academic term remaining after the internship

• Research experience in an area related to knowledge representation, information

retrieval, data management or contextual information systems for AI

• Strong programming skills and experience developing experimental research

software

• Understanding of contemporary AI systems and how retrieval and contextual

information support modern reasoning or agentic workflows

• Experience formulating research questions and designing empirical evaluations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Research experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

• Knowledge graphs or graph-based information systems

• Advanced information retrieval and hybrid retrieval methods

• Retrieval-augmented generation, including GraphRAG or related approaches

• Context engineering or memory architectures for AI systems

• Semantic and structured knowledge representation

• Temporal, provenance-aware or evolving data systems

• Heterogeneous data integration at scale

• Graph machine learning applied to representation or retrieval

A strong research publication record in a relevant area is desirable

  

Prior experience with architecture, engineering or construction is not required. We are

particularly interested in candidates with deep technical expertise who are motivated by the

opportunity to test their research against a complex real-world information environment.

  

**About the Team**

Autodesk Research explores technologies that may shape how the world is designed and

made. We work across fundamental and applied research, developing new ideas and testing

them against problems grounded in professional practice.

The Intelligent Construction team investigates how emerging forms of AI can support a more

connected and adaptive construction industry. An important part of that challenge is

understanding how fragmented project information can become a coherent and evolving

source of knowledge for intelligent systems.

You will join a multidisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning AI, data

systems, software engineering and construction. You will work closely with experienced

researchers while having substantial ownership of your own research problem.

Expected Research Outcome

This is a focused **12-week research internship**. The research question will be developed with

the successful candidate to make use of their existing expertise while addressing a problem

relevant to the team's research direction.

By the end of the internship, we expect the intern to have developed and evaluated an original

approach to a clearly defined research problem. This should include a working research

prototype, rigorous experimental evidence and a clear account of the findings and limitations.

The work will be shared within Autodesk Research. Where the research contribution warrants

it, we would expect to develop the work toward publication at an appropriate academic

venue.

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

#### **About the role**

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As a Product Builder in the Acquiring domain, you'll take end-to-end ownership of initiatives: framing the problem in a short design document, prototyping a solution, demoing to peers and stakeholders, shipping to production, and staying close enough to see whether it actually helped.

The surface area is broad: payment acceptance (authorization, capture, refunds, disputes), the payment-facilitator layer (sub-merchant data, identifiers, card scheme compliance), acceptance expansion across markets, and reporting into our ledger.

You'll work in a small domain team with no management layer in between. The tribe's Product Manager and Staff Engineer help with direction where relevant, but you won't be waiting for it. You'll set scope, run experiments, make calls, and run what you build.

Hospitality payments are at an inflection point. Hotels want payments that are embedded, transparent, and cheaper to run, and the gap between what exists and what's possible is real. Product Builders in Fintech close that gap.

#### **What you would do**

* Take end-to-end ownership of product initiatives in Acquiring: defining the problem, prototyping the solution, shipping to production, and iterating based on real customer feedback.

* Leverage AI to ship faster, set the standard for how it is used in the development process across the tribe, and build reusable approaches that accelerate other domains.

* Working knowledge of the card payment lifecycle: 3DS/SCA, IC++ pricing, chargebacks and

An excellent opportunity to join the in-house Governance Team.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Protection Officer.  This role is responsible for ensuring Methodist Homes (MHA) complies with all relevant data protection and privacy legislation, including the UK General Data Protection Regulations (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018, the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations and the Access to Health Records Act 1990. Reporting to the General Counsel/Company Secretary, the Data Protection Officer (DPO) acts as the organisation’s lead expert on data protection, providing advice, guidance, and assurance to managers, employees, and anyone processing personal data on MHA’s behalf. The role leads the response to personal data breaches, ensuring incidents are investigated, reported to the ICO where required, corrective actions are implemented, and lessons learned are embedded across the organisation. The DPO also manages requests from individuals exercising their data protection rights and ensures these are handled promptly and effectively.

A key aspect of the role is monitoring and improving compliance across the organisation. This includes maintaining records required by legislation, conducting regular data protection audits and compliance reviews, managing the annual NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT) submission, and ensuring colleagues complete the required data protection and information governance training. * **Make your work easy to build and review.** Keep designs, intended behavior, edge cases and decision notes clear enough that teammates can follow them without a live walkthrough. Seek critique early and use it to improve the work.
* **Follow the design into the product.** Review implementations with teammates, identify confusing or broken interactions, and help resolve them. Learn how design decisions translate into the shipped product.
