## Job Description

### Overview

As a Lead ML/AI Platform Engineer at SavvyMoney, you will own the platform that takes machine learning from experiment to production — training infrastructure, model serving, inference pipelines, and the integration seams with our Java microservices.

You will set technical direction for AI/ML across the company alongside our Data Platform Architect, and drive the engineering side of our GenAI/LLM and agent strategy — from retrieval architectures and evaluation harnesses to the guardrails required to run agentic workflows responsibly in a regulated environment.

## What You'll Do

* Partner with our Data Platform Architect to set technical direction for AI/ML across the company — architecture, tooling, standards, and build-vs-buy decisions.
* Own the ML/AI platform: training infrastructure, model serving, inference pipelines, and production integration.

  + Feature engineering, model training, model registry, and hosted inference in Amazon SageMaker
  + GenAI/LLM usage, fine-tuning, and agentic workflows in Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore
  + Feedback and data pipelines built on AWS Glue, Lambda, and Step Functions
* Own the serving layer and integrate ML services cleanly with our Java microservices — define the API contracts and make the latency and throughput trade-offs.
* Drive the engineering side of our GenAI/LLM strategy: retrieval architectures, evaluation harnesses, serving patterns, and the judgment calls about which approach fits which problem.
* Bring depth on the emerging agent stack — MCP, agent workflow patterns, stateless and stateful designs, and the guardrails needed to run them responsibly in a regulated environment.
* Partner with our Data Scientist on the handoff from experimentation to production: productionize models, stand up the feature pipelines and serving infrastructure they need, and shorten the loop between training and deployment.
* Work with product, data, and engineering leadership to identify the highest-impact ML opportunities and translate them into roadmaps.
* Represent the AI/ML function in cross-functional forums, communicating trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

## What We're Looking For

**Required**

* 8+ years in software or ML engineering, including 5+ years shipping production ML systems and a track record of owning ambiguous, high-scope problems end to end.
* Demonstrated technical leadership: you've shaped the ML strategy of a team or organization, mentored senior engineers, and been the person others rely on for difficult architectural calls.
* Hands-on experience with both operating models we use:

  + **AWS managed ML stack:** Amazon SageMaker (training, tuning, hosted endpoints, model registry), Amazon Bedrock, and AgentCore for GenAI and agentic workflows.
  + **Open-source ML tooling:** JupyterLab for notebooks, Spark for distributed processing, MLflow for experiment tracking and model registry.
* Deep working knowledge of the AWS stack — S3, Athena, Redshift, Glue, Step Functions, Lambda — plus SQL skills strong enough to model data for both analytical and ML workloads.
* Production experience with GenAI/LLMs: RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation, and a clear grasp of the cost, latency, and safety trade-offs involved.
* Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone) and sound judgment on when they're warranted versus alternatives such as NoSQL retrieval.
* Working knowledge of Java sufficient to review service code, define API contracts, and debug integration issues with our microservices.
* Deep expertise in Python and the core ML stack: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, XGBoost / LightGBM.
* Solid MLOps fundamentals — model monitoring, drift detection, reproducibility, experiment tracking, model registry, and cost observability — plus the ability to partner with DevOps on CI/CD rather than build it from scratch.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write both the design doc that aligns a dozen engineers and the one-pager that aligns the exec team.
* Strong collaborator, comfortable operating in a role where scope is shared: you'll partner with a Data Scientist on models and DevOps on infrastructure, and you can navigate those seams while keeping clear ownership.
* Ability to operate as an independent contractor through your own entity or an approved contracting arrangement, with reliable overlap with US Pacific business hours for architecture reviews and cross-team work.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with ClickHouse or a comparable columnar / real-time analytical database.
* Fine-tuning experience (LoRA / QLoRA, instruction tuning, or RLHF).
* Streaming and real-time inference experience (Kafka, Kinesis, low-latency serving).
* Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation).
* Experience operating ML systems at meaningful scale — hundreds of millions of predictions per day, or equivalent.
* Open-source contributions, conference talks, papers, or patents in ML / applied ML.

## Who You'll Work With

* **Data Scientist** — leads feature engineering, model training, fine-tuning, and experimentation. You'll partner on the research-to-production handoff, stand up the infrastructure they need, and jointly own the quality of what ships.
* **DevOps** — owns CI/CD, deployment infrastructure, and platform observability. You'll partner on ML-specific extensions (model artifacts, reproducible environments, canary and shadow deployments) rather than rebuilding what already exists.
* **Backend engineers** — own the Java microservices that consume ML outputs. You'll define the contracts and own the serving side.
* **Product and engineering leadership** — you're the technical voice on what we should build with AI/ML, and how.

## Our Stack

* **Distributed processing:** AWS Glue
* **Orchestration:** AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions
* **Managed ML:** Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore
* **Open-source ML:** JupyterLab, Spark, MLflow
* **Storage & query:** Amazon S3 (data lake), Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, ClickHouse
* **Languages:** Python (ML, pipelines), Java (microservices)  
    
  **Why This Role Matters**

  Credit data is the core of what we do, and the opportunity to make it smarter — better offer targeting, better personalization, better insight for 1,600+ financial institutions and the consumers they serve — runs directly through the ML platform. Today that platform is early. You will be the person who defines what it becomes.

  Your decisions on architecture, tooling, and evaluation will set the ceiling on what every ML-driven feature at SavvyMoney can do for years.

  Join us at SavvyMoney and help build the AI foundation of a platform trusted by 1,600+ banks and credit unions.

**Additionally we provide**

* Equity Compensation Package
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) - take time off as needed to rest and recharge.
* Medical, Dental, Vision – 100% premium paid for employee
* Disability/Life Insurance
* Opportunity for learning and career growth with a top Bay Area technology company
* Reimbursement for remote work setup
* Monthly stipend for phone and internet
* Team building events, culture activities, all hands events
* Paid time off to volunteer and serve the community

:   # Registered Children's Home Manager

    **Salary:** £55,162 - £58,523 per annum (£26.52 - £28.14 per hour)  
    **Bonus:** Eligible for the Ofsted Bonus Scheme  
    **Location:** Spondon, Derbyshire  
    **Home:** Hazel House

    Since opening our first home in 2007, Homes2Inspire, part of Shaw Trust, has grown to become the UK's largest charity-owned provider of residential children's homes. Today, we operate more than 60 homes, supported accommodation services, and high-needs foster care provision, with ambitious plans for further growth.

    Homes2Inspire is seeking a dedicated, resilient, and ambitious **Registered Children's Home Manager** to lead **Hazel House**, our established two-bed children's home in **Spondon, Derbyshire**.

    This is an exciting opportunity to build on the strong foundations already in place, continuing to provide a safe, nurturing, and therapeutic environment where children and young people can thrive. We are looking for a leader who can confidently navigate complex situations, inspire a team, and maintain a clear focus on achieving positive long-term outcomes for children and young people.

    ## About the Home

    Hazel House is a well-established two-bed children's home located in **Spondon, Derbyshire**, providing a safe, nurturing, and therapeutic environment for children and young people with complex emotional and behavioural needs.

    The home is currently rated **Good by Ofsted** and has a dedicated team committed to delivering high-quality care and positive outcomes for young people.

    Hazel House focuses on providing stability, therapeutic support, and opportunities for children and young people to develop resilience, independence, and confidence.

    As Registered Manager, you will lead an established service, supporting and developing an experienced team while driving continuous improvement and maintaining high standards of care, safeguarding, and regulatory compliance.

    ## About Homes2Inspire

    Homes2Inspire is proud to be part of the Shaw Trust Group and the UK's largest charity-owned provider of residential children's homes.

    We are committed to creating environments where children feel safe, valued, and supported to achieve their full potential. With the vast majority of our homes rated Good or Outstanding by Ofsted, we continue to invest in exceptional leaders who share our passion for transforming young lives.

    ## Key Responsibilities

    As Registered Home Manager, you will:

    * Lead and manage a specialist residential service supporting two young people with complex needs.
    * Ensure outstanding standards of care, safeguarding, and regulatory compliance.
    * Develop and inspire a resilient, high-performing team that embodies Homes2Inspire values.
    * Promote therapeutic, trauma-informed practice throughout the service.
    * Work collaboratively across a supportive cluster of homes, sharing expertise and best practice.
    * Build positive relationships with Derby City Council, external agencies, commissioners, and stakeholders.
    * Monitor quality, outcomes, and service performance to drive continuous improvement.
    * Lead on recruitment, development, supervision, and performance management of staff.
    * Manage budgets, resources, and occupancy effectively.
    * Create a nurturing environment where children and young people can flourish.

    ## What We're Looking For

    We're seeking a passionate and child-focused leader who brings resilience, compassion, and strong leadership skills.

    You'll ideally have:

    * Experience within children's residential care, including leadership or management responsibilities.
    * Strong knowledge of safeguarding, Children's Homes Regulations, and Quality Standards.
    * Experience supporting children and young people with complex needs.
    * Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
    * The ability to build and maintain effective partnerships with stakeholders and external agencies.
    * A commitment to achieving positive outcomes for children and young people.
    * The resilience to manage a demanding but highly rewarding service.

    **Ambitious Deputy Managers looking to take the next step into Registered Management are encouraged to apply.**

    ## What We Offer

    * **Salary of £55,162 - £58,523 per annum (£26.52 - £28.14 per hour).**
    * **Children's Home Managers Bonus Scheme.**
    * **Ofsted Bonus Scheme** for achieving Good and Outstanding inspection outcomes.
    * **Enhanced Family Friendly Leave.**
    * **Award and Recognition Vouchers** celebrating exceptional contributions and achievements.
    * **Opportunity to lead an established, Ofsted-rated Good children's home in partnership with Derby City Council.**
    * Comprehensive management training and leadership development.
    * Three weeks of paid mandatory training.
    * Structured career progression opportunities across a growing national organisation.
    * Unum Healthcare, providing healthcare reimbursements, remote GP access, wellbeing resources, and mental health support.
    * Aviva Digicare, including Digital GP appointments, annual health checks, and mental health assessments.
    * Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) with free counselling and wellbeing support.
    * Dedicated wellbeing support services.
    * Generous annual leave entitlement, with the option to purchase additional days.
    * Blue Light Card eligibility.
    * Discounts on shopping, cinema tickets, travel, and holidays.
    * Cycle to Work Scheme.
    * Refer a Friend Scheme.
    * Christmas vouchers and long-service recognition awards.
    * Access to Shaw Trust employee networks and inclusion groups.

    ## Please Note

    All successful candidates will be subject to pre-employment safer recruitment checks in line with Ofsted regulatory requirements and Homes2Inspire's Safer Recruitment Policy.

    We are unable to offer sponsorship for this role.

    Applications will be reviewed regularly, and we reserve the right to interview candidates before the advertised closing date.

    Due to our partnership working with Derby City Council, personal information provided by applicants may be shared with our partner organisation as part of the recruitment process.

    Interviews will take place in person during planned assessment days. Please contact our Careers Team if you require reasonable adjustments or accessibility support.

    ## Our Commitment to Inclusion

    At Homes2Inspire, we're committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone feels valued and respected.

    We actively encourage applications from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, people with disabilities, individuals with lived experience of social exclusion, and care-experienced people.

    Male staff are currently under-represented within our residential childcare services and, while appointments are made solely on merit, we welcome applications from men to help create diverse and balanced teams.

    As part of our safer recruitment process, suitable candidates may occasionally be considered for alternative Homes2Inspire services where appropriate.

    ## Ready to Build on Success?

# Integrated Photonics Engineer/Senior Integrated Photonics Engineer

Bristol-based health tech start-up Siloton seeks a skilled and innovative technical lead who is interested in applying their photonics engineering skills to improve the lives of people with eye disease.

Role overview:

* In-person position (hybrid options available).
* Full-time preferred, part-time applications considered.
* Core role as part of an interdisciplinary technical team
* Must have the right to work in the UK.
* Starting as soon as possible

## What we do

Four hundred and twenty million people suffer from chronic eye disease; it is the leading cause of sight loss in the developed world. To prevent people going blind, clinicians take sub-surface images of the back of the eye so that the condition can be diagnosed and managed appropriately. This uses a device called an optical coherence tomography machine, or ‘OCT’, which currently require bulky, desk-sized workstations. Siloton is developing the first truly portable OCT to provide better access to diagnostic and monitoring services for everyone who needs it. Based on Siloton’s world-leading photonic chip technology, this will reduce the burden of treatment while removing bottlenecks in the clinical pipeline, alleviating pressure on healthcare systems and ensuring patients receive the best possible care, wherever and whoever they are.

## What we are looking for

Your role will be to work on the development of core integrated photonic capabilities as part of the dedicated and passionate engineering team of photonic, hardware, and software specialists working to create the next generation of retinal scanning device. The chip projects as part of this role will feed into a larger set of development goals leading towards direct imaging of patients and development of a device for clinical trials.

This is a wide-ranging technical role, covering many aspects of integrated photonics, with a diverse and interesting set of problems to solve. Your primary responsibilities will be to work with the CTO to complete the design, development, and implementation of photonic chips fundamental to prototype development and patient imaging. This includes but is not limited to:

1. Simulating and designing photonic integrated circuit (PICs) components using FDTD packages such as Lumerical or similar suites
2. Completing layout of PICs at both multi-project wafer and full-wafer scale using GDS Factory, Nazca, or similar software
3. Testing, characterising, and demonstrating the functionality of existing and new photonic chip devices, including imaging via in-vivo and patient trials
4. Constructing and demonstrating prototype imaging devices incorporating photonic chips
5. Assembly, testing, and installation of commercial (pre-regulated) devices to customers
6. Establishing alignment/characterisation/assembly/manufacturing procedures as we move towards product launch
7. IP generation and protection, including patent writing
8. Liaising with collaborators, suppliers, and customers where required

Supplementary to this, there are additional opportunities to get involved with other work at Siloton based on personal interest, including but not limited to:

1. A chance to engage and do technical development with our academic and clinical partners and advisors
2. Providing technical input to business and customer development
3. Direct experience with investor and fundraising activities
4. Developing technology under a medical device quality management system (ISO-13485)
5. Working with a broader team to develop technology for assessment in a formal clinical trial

The position includes the opportunity to gain experience in, and exposure to, many areas of integrated photonic design and implementation from core design and development through to direct user engagement (patient imaging). The role will have a primary focus on photonic chip engineering and demonstrations with the Siloton system, including integration and work with the wider electronic, photonic, and software systems. As the company progresses, the early entry of the person into the company will allow for growth of the role and the opportunity to take on more responsibility.

There will be opportunities for mentorship and training through both internal and external personnel.

## Experience

The below requirements are to be used as guidelines to the role. We want to hear from anyone with an interest in applying for the role, even if you only meet some of the essential criteria.

### Essential

2. Experience in development/experimentation/R&D using photonic integrated circuits

5. Experience in using Python
6. Enjoy working as part of a team

### Desirable

1. PhD in a relevant discipline

3. Medical device, OCT, industry, or startup experience
4. Strong written and oral communication skills

## Working at Siloton

Siloton is developing a device for all to use and so we welcome and encourage applications from people from all backgrounds and walks of life. Flexible working options are available for this role.

We value everyone’s contributions equally, striving to ensure that our employees always have the opportunity to gain new skills and provide input into the direction of the company. Siloton is highly invested in supporting and developing employees as they form an integral part of the company and its success.

Siloton offers a dynamic working environment that bridges between cutting edge science and working with patients to understand their needs and challenges. The team is committed, driven by impact, and highly supportive.

### How to apply

Please send a CV and cover letter to recruitment@siloton.com. Applicants will be interviewed on a rolling basis so are encouraged to apply early.

**Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.**

We do not use AI tools to assess or screen candidates that apply for our roles. All assessments and interviews are carried out by people working for Siloton. Our process is:

Working with business stakeholders, source-product owners and data engineering, you will turn business needs into clear requirements, deliver dependable datasets and establish definitions and relationships that can be reused across products.

## **What you’ll do:**

* **Own the strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of shared data products, with a focus on developing new datasets to meet emerging business needs.** Understand needs across teams, identify valuable opportunities and prioritise a portfolio of initiatives that supports artist teams and the wider business.
* **Turn business requests into well-defined data initiatives.** Meet the people who produce and use the data, examine source datasets and establish the questions users need to answer, the information required and the measures of success.
* **Define reusable datasets with engineering.** Agree on the records, fields, relationships, quality, freshness and access requirements needed for each use case you’re defining. Establish clear acceptance criteria and resolve tradeoffs with stakeholders and engineers.
* **Lead delivery and adoption.** Maintain a prioritised backlog and work with engineering through implementation, validation, launch and ongoing improvement. Ensure the teams receiving the data can use it to meet the agreed need.
* **Steward shared definitions and data models.** Work with domain experts and engineers to establish consistent definitions, identifiers, relationships and metrics. Develop the shared semantic layer through the initiatives you deliver, so concepts such as artists, tracks, markets, campaigns and audiences can be understood consistently across products.
* **Connect datasets to enable new capabilities.** Identify where combining data creates value and lead the product work required, including opportunities to relate streaming performance to social activity, campaigns, fan engagement and commerce.
* **Make data discoverable and understandable.** Ensure data products have clear documentation, usage examples and known limitations, helping analysts, data scientists and downstream product teams use them confidently.
* **Help develop and apply practical data standards.** Partner with leadership, engineering and relevant specialists on quality, ownership, access, lineage and appropriate use. Translate these expectations into requirements for the data products you lead.
* **Agree responsibilities for ongoing use of the data products you deliver.** Work with source-product owners and engineering teams to establish how source changes, maintenance, quality issues and communication with users will be handled for those initiatives.
* **Measure adoption and impact.** Gather user feedback and evidence of usefulness, track whether the capabilities delivered meet their intended outcomes and use those findings to inform the roadmap.
* **Build stakeholder alignment.** Explain priorities and investment decisions, communicate progress and translate technical considerations into clear business implications.

You will work closely with our existing Data Platform product and engineering teams, coordinating priorities and dependencies with the platform migration and operational roadmap. You will also partner with source-product PMs and the teams building on the shared data products you deliver.

## **Who you are:**

* You have a track record of leading data products or platform capabilities from discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption and ongoing improvement.
* You can set a clear product direction and prioritise pragmatically, balancing business value, user needs, technical constraints and dependencies across teams
* You are comfortable examining source data and working through detailed requirements with business experts, analysts and engineers..
* You have experience turning fragmented data and business requirements into reusable datasets, shared capabilities or data products that support multiple use cases.
* You have a strong understanding of modern data platforms, including Snowflake or comparable cloud data warehouses, and can work effectively with engineers on data ingestion, modelling, pipelines and downstream consumption.
* You understand semantic layers and shared data definitions, and can work with business and technical partners to establish consistent meaning across products and domains.
* You can make informed product decisions about data quality, freshness, ownership, access and lineage, with an understanding of privacy and appropriate data use.
* You are comfortable working across product boundaries, clarifying responsibilities and influencing teams whose roadmaps and priorities may differ.
* You have strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to translate complex problems into clear requirements, priorities and delivery plans.
* You communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders and executives, creating alignment around both the work and the outcomes it should deliver.
* You have strong documentation skills and can make data products, definitions and decisions understandable to the teams that depend on them.
* You focus on whether people can use and rely on the capabilities you deliver, with experience measuring adoption, usefulness and business impact.

## **Bonus Points:**

* Experience with fan engagement, social and creator analytics, marketing campaigns, D2C commerce or customer data platforms.
* Experience connecting data across platforms through shared identifiers, entity relationships or audience segmentation.

London, England

During your Year in Industry as Business Analyst, you will be trained and exposed to digital distribution deal structures and strategies. You will gain an understanding of how music copyrights are licensed, of the general structure of our industry, and of how commercial agreements with global and multi-territory digital partners are negotiated and executed. You will grow your ability to summarise complex thoughts, crystallise situations and potential options, isolate action points and communicate them effectively in writing to stakeholders. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with analysts, dealmakers and senior leaders in London and New York, gaining insight into commercial decision-making that most students only encounter years into their careers.

You’ll be responsible for developing design concepts into coordinated, buildable technical information, ensuring drawings are accurate, detailed and issued in line with project programmes.

Working across our London office, home and live project sites, you’ll collaborate with the wider team, consultants, subcontractors and contractors to help ensure our designs translate seamlessly from the drawing board to the finished space.

* Review site conditions and communicate any discrepancies between drawings and the actual build.
* Support the smooth transition from design development through to tender, construction and installation.

* Prepare and issue coordinated tender and construction drawing packages in line with project programmes.
* Maintain drawing registers, revision histories and document control processes.
* Ensure drawings are clearly annotated, appropriately detailed and issued to the correct parties.
* Manage competing deadlines across multiple workstreams, prioritising deliverables to keep projects moving.
* Communicate progress, outstanding information and potential delays to the wider team.

## About You

You’ll be a technically minded designer with experience producing construction-ready drawing packages, ideally within commercial office interiors, workplace design or fit-out.

You’re comfortable working independently, managing your workload and collaborating with a wider project team. You understand that good technical design isn’t just about how a space looks — it’s about making sure it can be built accurately, efficiently and to the intended standard.

* Excellent organisation, attention to detail and drawing revision management.
* The confidence to work autonomously, communicate clearly and deliver to tight deadlines.
* A practical, solutions-focused approach and the ability to hit the ground running.

Experience with Revit, SketchUp or other relevant design software would be beneficial, but strong technical drawing and delivery skills are the priority.

## What We’re Looking For

This is a short-term contract, so we’re looking for someone who can make an immediate impact. You’ll be comfortable picking up existing projects, understanding the design intent quickly and producing the technical information needed to keep delivery on track.

You’ll be collaborative, proactive and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in creating well-designed workplaces. You’ll care about the details, but you’ll also understand the bigger picture: delivering great spaces for our clients, on programme and to a high standard.

If you’re an experienced Technical Designer who can hit the ground running and help us deliver exceptional commercial workplaces, we’d love to hear from you.

Alongside our branded portfolio, we’re a leading supplier of delicious own-label pastry, sweet bakery, party food, olives and antipasti, added-value egg products, continental meats, dips and sauces and plant-based food to the UK’s major retailers, as well as across foodservice.

With over 6,000 talented colleagues across 17 sites, and an annual turnover of £1.3bn, we’re united by a shared ambition to shape the future of food for the better.

**What you'll be doing**

As our Raw Material Quality Auditor, you'll be one of the first lines of defence in protecting our product quality. You'll work closely with our Operations and Technical teams to make sure everything coming into our site is up to standard.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* Checking quality from the start: Inspecting and verifying incoming raw materials and packaging against agreed supplier specifications.
* Keeping standards high: Auditing storage areas and ensuring food safety, hygiene and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) procedures are followed.
* Spotting and solving problems: Identifying non-conformances, working with suppliers and internal teams, and ensuring corrective actions are completed.
* Monitoring temperatures: Checking temperature-controlled storage areas, fridges and equipment to ensure products are kept in the right conditions.
* Supporting food safety: Collecting samples and following testing procedures to help protect the quality, safety and legality of our products.
* Being audit-ready: Maintaining accurate records, supporting traceability and helping the team prepare for internal and external audits.
* Working together: Communicating quality findings, trends and concerns to colleagues across the business.
* Driving improvements: Looking for smarter, safer and more efficient ways of working while maintaining our high standards.

**What we're looking for**

We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys problem-solving and understands why quality matters in food manufacturing.

* Previous experience in a food manufacturing, quality assurance or technical environment.
* Good knowledge of food safety, GMP and allergen management.
* An understanding of non-conformance reporting and corrective actions.
* Basic microbiological awareness and knowledge of food safety principles.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
* Confidence using Microsoft Office and maintaining accurate records.
* Great communication skills and a positive, team-focused attitude.
* The ability to think on your feet, make decisions and adapt to changing priorities.
* GCSE-level education (or equivalent), including good literacy and numeracy skills.

* Level 3 Food Safety qualification.
* Level 2 Health & Safety qualification.

IT Support Specialist

The Fuel Store (TFS) is a progressive, Birmingham based business using technology to develop its market and stay ahead of the competition. It is on a mission to revolutionise the way business is conducted in its chosen business segments. The business is a leading provider of fuel and associated products into the transportation sector, providing a range of products and solutions to its customers to increase profits through increasing share of wallet, customer loyalty and usage; serving customers more efficiently and cost-effectively. It currently facilitates the provision of and processes the transactions to allow 65 million litres of Fuel per annum through its card processes.

The business was started 10 years ago and to date has grown organically. Future development will be a combination of organic and inorganic growth offering its customers a carefully thought-out package of products with software that enables easy/dynamic/cost optimised fleet management at its core.

The business is very efficient and proudly operates with circa 50 colleagues whilst delivering nearly £100m of turnover. It means that the senior management team need to be able to operate at both the strategic and operational level often in the same meeting. The ability to ‘roll up your sleeves’ and deliver your own solutions is a hugely important asset to us.

The business buys fuel weekly and as such prices to its customers weekly (alongside the whole market). The pricing dynamics are complex and vary between the different networks supported and circa 6k customers we sell to. Following a year of transition and systems investment on the fuel business, the organisation is now looking to strengthen its wider Fleet Management capabilities. It is currently assessing which products/services to build itself or white label or buy the capability.

The IT Support Specialist will work alongside the IT Director in supporting the technology solutions which will keep the business ahead of its competitors. The jobholder will need to have a personality that understands the dynamics of working in a smaller business which involves both the origination of fresh ideas/ways of working as well as executing for their delivery.

It is worth noting the Company systems are based on Microsoft solutions and therefore exposure to these solutions will be a distinct advantage.

You will be hands on with all things hardware and software, ensuring that you can work effectively across the business and with third party support teams  

Brief Overview:

Type of Opportunity: Permanent, Full Time

Basic Salary: £45k base

Bonus: Company bonus programme

Location: Birmingham, (4 days per week expected in the office)

Reports to: IT Director

Key Responsibilities of the IT SUPPORT SPECIALIST:

* Become the internal expert on all core applications and provide first and second line technical support.
* Training end-users on hardware functionality and software programs.
* Resolving logged errors in a timely manner.
* Provide technical support during new product/system implementations and internal change projects.
* Assisting in deploying new system functionality.

* Liaise with third party suppliers and partners to assist in implementations, conduct high-level troubleshooting, and/or escalate issues.
* Administer the setup of new hardware and software for new starters (along with ad hoc hardware/software set up across the business).
* Monitoring hardware, software, and system performance metrics.
* Updating computer software, as well as upgrading hardware and systems.
* Maintaining databases and ensuring system security.
* Documenting processes and performing diagnostic tests.
* Keeping track of technological advancements and trends in IT support.
* Contribute to the strategy for systems architecture
* Ensure the Company has buy in to the strategies through clear articulation of the plans

 

 

To have the ability to contribute to The Fuel Store’s success, you will need the following knowledge, skills and experience:

* Likely to be a graduate
* Demonstrable all round experience of IT matters including:
  + Microsoft dynamics solutions including Power BI
  + Cloud architecture
  + Networking
  + Disaster recovery
  + Identity and access management
  + ERP systems
  + CRM solutions
  + AI implementation
  + Data Warehousing
* Confidence in executing hands‐on work within a lean environment.
* Experience managing suppliers, negotiating commercial contracts, and evaluating partner performance.
* Excellent communication skills, able to create compelling commercial narratives for senior leadership.

Desired:

* Experience of managing IT budgets
* Exposure to the wider corporate decision making process and budget processes
* Experience within fuel cards, fleet, mobility, payments, or loyalty sectors.
* Experience using MS dynamics CRM product suite

As well as having the right experience, a Fueller will have:

* Great aptitude for problem solving and a naturally inquisitive mind
* Ability to challenge the status quo; actively seeking to understand HOW something works, not just WHY

* Excellent communicator and act as an “ambassador” for all stakeholders
* Resilience and ability to understand and translate complex information into simple actionable instructions
* Ability to be methodical and logical when making decisions
* Attention to detail with a real pride in your work.
* Excellent organisation and time management

* Thriving in a fast-paced environment
* Being commercially savvy

What’s in it for you?

* Pension Scheme: After 12 weeks of continuous employment, you will be automatically enrolled into our Pension Scheme.
* Health & Wellbeing: All employees will have access to MediCash upon passing their probation, this will allow them to access retail discounts, counselling, and so much more.
* Holiday Entitlement: You will be entitled to increase personal holiday allowance with increased service, as well as your birthday and work anniversary off.
* Career Progression: We track all employees progression by creating personal development plans, we have a fueller academy in place to also support this.
* Incentives & Good Commission: We offer uncapped commission for our Sales agents, as well as regular incentives for everyone across the business to get involved in.
* Location: Based in Birmingham City Centre, with panoramic views from the office floor. We offer remote working per week too at discretion of your manager.
* Other benefits: Monthly employee awards, which would include a lunch provided. Have the last Friday of the month off\*. Regular in-house competitions and games. Tea, coffee, fresh fruit & breakfast are available for everyone in the business.

A little more for you to know..

We're looking for a **Blockchain Intelligence Analyst** to operate as a high-judgment, high-autonomy individual contributor specializing in ransomware. In this role, you'll leverage blockchain analytics, cyber threat intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution to trace ransomware proceeds, identify threat actor infrastructure, and generate actionable intelligence that supports investigations, disruption efforts, and evidentiary workflows.

This is not a people-management role. We're looking for an experienced analyst who can independently lead complex investigations, develop high-confidence assessments, uncover novel attribution, and elevate the team's tradecraft through technical expertise, mentorship, and example.

You should be equally comfortable tracing funds across blockchains, identifying laundering and cash-out infrastructure, correlating technical, financial, and behavioral signals, and synthesizing fragmented data into clear, defensible intelligence that enables internal and external partners to make informed operational decisions.  
  
**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Produce impactful finished intelligence on ransomware actors, affiliates, facilitators, and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, lead packages, attribution assessments, and operational reporting suitable for investigative, executive, and partner audiences.
* Lead complex end-to-end blockchain investigations from initial seed indicators such as victim payment addresses, deposit addresses, transactions, exchange exposure, infrastructure leads, or IP-linked activity through to full attribution and actionable recovery or disruption opportunities.
* Trace ransomware-related funds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains, and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties, cash-out services, and recovery touchpoints.
* Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, threat intelligence, attribution partner data, and off-chain identity or infrastructure signals to build a complete picture of adversary behavior within the broader cybercrime ecosystem.
* Own investigative workstreams from discovery through validation, escalation, and written production, including drafting intelligence products that are source-cited, auditable, and operationally useful.
* Support TRM’s ransomware asset recovery mission by surfacing high-quality leads, identifying seizure or freeze opportunities, and helping partners move quickly before funds are off-ramped.
* Drive analytical leadership across active ransomware investigations by prioritizing work, maintaining rigorous standards, and mentoring other analysts without formal people management responsibilities.
* Partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, including investigators, threat intelligence teammates, product teams, and public-sector or private-sector partners, to ensure analytical outputs reflect real investigative tradecraft and support cross-functional operations.
* Help strengthen TRM’s ransomware coverage by contributing new attribution, refining investigative methodologies, and improving repeatable workflows for lead generation and asset recovery support.
* Support external briefings, customer or partner engagements, and capability-building sessions where ransomware tracing, attribution, and recovery tradecraft must be explained clearly and credibly.

## **What Success Looks Like:**

* You generate meaningful attribution, investigative leads, and recovery opportunities in ransomware cases where the answers are not obvious, and the financial trail is deliberately obscured.
* You consistently produce finished intelligence that partners trust and use in operational, investigative, and strategic contexts.
* Your work helps TRM and its partners move faster on high-priority ransomware activity without sacrificing rigor, auditability, or defensibility.
* You improve team capability by mentoring peers, refining tradecraft, and strengthening repeatable workflows for ransomware investigations and asset recovery support.
* You help make blockchain-enabled financial intelligence a differentiator in how TRM understands, attributes, and disrupts ransomware activity across the cybercrime ecosystem.

## **What We’re Looking For:**

* **5-8+ years of professional experience** in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cybercrime analysis, threat intelligence, financial crime investigations, or a comparable senior analytical role.
* **Blockchain tracing expertise** — Deep hands-on experience tracing funds across multiple blockchains and through laundering or obfuscation techniques such as mixers, chain-hopping, bridges, peel chains, and layered cash-out behavior.
* **Extensive investigative tradecraft** — Demonstrated ability to independently run complex investigations and synthesize findings into clear written intelligence products, including investigative assessments, lead packages, fund-flow analysis, and attribution reporting.
* **Ransomware domain expertise** — including a deep understanding of the broader cybercrime ecosystem and the relationships among ransomware operators, affiliates, initial access brokers, malware developers, laundering networks, and cash-out services.
* **Excellent written and verbal communication** — especially the ability to turn technically complex tracing findings into understandable, actionable intelligence for government and private-sector audiences.
* **Judgment and execution** — Strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where timing matters and outputs must still stand up to scrutiny.
* **AI fluency** — Experience leveraging AI tools and large language models (LLMs) to accelerate research, surface insights, and augment analytical workflows, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance.

## **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with OSINT, cybercrime infrastructure research, and cross-domain analytical methods that combine blockchain activity with off-chain signals and adversary behavior.
* Comfort with modern investigative tooling, including AI and structured data environments such as TRM, Maltego, Palantir, or similar platforms.
* Experience conducting HUMINT collection and engaging threat actors via dark web forums and encrypted messaging platforms.
* Experience mentoring peers, shaping analytical standards, or improving investigative workflows without formal people management.

# Payroll Tax and Compliance Analyst

Remote - Ireland

**Who we are**

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.  
.

**Hiring and how we work**

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.   
.

**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Payroll Tax and Compliance Analyst.

**About the job**

We are seeking a highly skilled Payroll Tax and Compliance Analyst to oversee payroll employment taxes, regulatory adherence, and mobility compliance across APJ and EMEA regions. As a fast-growing tech company, our workforce is highly mobile. You will serve as the subject matter expert on complex tax laws, social security frameworks, and multi-country remote worker regulations. Reporting directly to the Director, Global Payroll, you will suggest risk-mitigation strategies and ensure seamless compliance for a dynamic, global team.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* **Tax Oversight:** Manage all payroll tax compliance, filings, and reconciliations across the APJ and EMEA regions, covering Australia, Singapore, India, Hong Kong, Japan, Sweden, Estonia, Spain, Ireland, UK, Germany, Belgium, France, Poland.
* **Mobility Tracking:** Monitor employee movement across countries and international borders to ensure accurate tax withholding.
* **Nexus Assessment:** Evaluate corporate tax footprint implications resulting from remote worker locations.
* **Social Security:** Ensure correct application of local social security taxes and international totalization agreements.
* **Regulatory Research:** Track changing tax laws, statutory rates, and local compliance requirements in all active jurisdictions.
* **Agency Management:** Act as the primary point of contact for tax authorities, external auditors, and local payroll partners.
* **Year-End Reporting:** Lead year-end tax reporting processes, for all countries in APJ & EMEA and follow local country statutory filings.
* **Process Optimization:** Build scalable internal workflows to automate tax adjustments for mobile employees.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

**Required:**

* Experience: 3+ years of payroll tax and compliance experience, ideally within a high-growth technology company.
* Geographic Scope: Proven expertise in APJ & EMEA local taxes & social security.
* Mobility Expertise: Advanced knowledge of multi-country taxation, trailing liabilities, and cross-border remote work risks.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency with global payroll platforms (e.g., Workday, Deel, etc).
* Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex statutory tax laws into clear, actionable corporate policies.

**Desired:**

* Expertise in APJ & EMEA payroll regulations (e.g., Australia, Singapore, India, Japan, Hong Kong, Sweden, UK, Spain, France, Germany, Ireland, Poland, Belgium)
* Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or equivalent international certification.
* Experience navigating compliance for equity compensation (RSUs, stock options) across multiple tax jurisdictions.

**Location**

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Twilio thinks big. Do you?**

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

**.**

**Stay alert to recruitment fraud**

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.  
  
.

**Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

They should be able to use SQL to investigate underlying data, understand relationships between datasets and how data moves through reporting solutions, troubleshoot discrepancies, and determine whether issues originate within the BI layer or upstream.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

**BI Development & Data Modeling**

* Design, build, and maintain datasets, reports, and dashboards within Zoho Analytics.
* Build and maintain data preparation processes, pipelines and other transformations within Zoho Analytics to support reporting and analytics.
* Create and maintain query tables, using SQL to combine, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analysis.
* Design and maintain data models within Zoho Analytics, including defining appropriate relationships between tables and selecting the correct relationship fields and cardinality, such as one-to-one and one-to-many relationships.
* Understand the impact of table relationships and data model changes on calculations, aggregation, and downstream reporting.
* Develop calculated fields, formulas, filters, and other reporting logic to produce accurate, meaningful outputs.
* Build clear, intuitive dashboards that enable users to understand and explore data effectively.
* Develop reusable datasets and reporting solutions where appropriate, reducing duplication and enabling greater self-service across the business.
* Apply good data modeling, transformation and data management practices when developing BI and analytics solutions, taking into account the structure and limitations of upstream source data.

**Ad Hoc Analytics & Data Investigation**

* Perform ad hoc analysis to answer business, operational, and research-related questions using available data.
* Use SQL to interrogate underlying datasets and warehouse data, including where analysis cannot be performed directly within Zoho Analytics.
* Investigate questions involving multiple data sources, criteria, or patient characteristics and provide accurate, clearly understood results.
* Determine whether recurring analytical requests are better addressed through a reusable dataset, query table, report, or dashboard, and develop these where appropriate.
* Investigate discrepancies or unexpected results within reports and dashboards and determine whether issues originate within the BI layer or upstream.
* Work with the Enterprise Data and Application teams when investigations identify an issue with an upstream data source or when a change is required, ensuring any changes are raised and managed through the appropriate process.

**Data Quality & Monitoring**

* Regularly monitor BI datasets, data preparation processes, pipelines, scheduled refreshes, reports and dashboards to ensure data remains current and reliable.
* Proactively identify failed or delayed refreshes, unexpected data volumes, missing data, unusual results, and other potential data quality issues.
* Investigate identified issues and coordinate with the appropriate teams to resolve them.
* Implement appropriate data quality checks and monitoring within the BI environment.
* Ensure reporting outputs continue to reconcile appropriately with their underlying data sources.

**Validation & Change Management**

* Assess dependencies and downstream impact before modifying existing data models, datasets, query tables, data preparation processes, pipelines, reports or dashboards.
* Ensure changes do not inadvertently break existing reporting or analytical outputs.
* Perform appropriate validation following BI changes and releases.
* Validate relevant BI datasets, reports, and dashboards following upstream releases or data changes that may affect reporting.
* Identify and communicate issues arising from releases and work with the appropriate team to ensure they are resolved.

**BI Platform Stewardship & Housekeeping**

* Help maintain a well-structured, reliable, and efficient Zoho Analytics environment in line with agreed standards and best practices.
* Regularly review datasets, data preparation processes, query tables, pipelines, scheduled imports and syncs, reports and dashboards to identify obsolete, duplicated or inefficient assets.
* Identify temporary datasets or processes that are no longer required and ensure unnecessary refreshes, syncs or processing are stopped.
* Streamline inefficient solutions where appropriate, while protecting existing dependencies and outputs.
* Make recommendations for improvements to the BI environment and ways of working.
* Work closely with relevant stakeholders when making changes that could affect existing reporting or users.

**Documentation**

* Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation for data models, datasets, data preparation processes, query tables, pipelines, reports and dashboards.
* Document important transformation logic, table relationships, calculations, dependencies, and data sources so that BI solutions can be understood and maintained.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of key metrics and reporting definitions.
* Ensure documentation is updated when solutions or underlying data structures change.

**Troubleshooting & Support**

* Troubleshoot BI-related issues including failed refreshes, broken reports, incorrect calculations, and unexpected data.
* When needed, investigate relevant source or warehouse data in AWS to determine the origin of an issue.
* Raise and manage support cases with Zoho when issues originate within the Zoho platform, provide appropriate diagnostic information, and follow issues through to resolution.
* Validate fixes and ensure affected reporting is functioning correctly following resolution.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Clinical, Commercial and other areas of the business to understand reporting and analytical requirements.
* Translate business questions into appropriate datasets, analyses, reports and dashboards.
* Clarify requirements, definitions, and expected outcomes before developing solutions.
* Work closely with the Enterprise Data and Application teams to understand available data, data models, source systems, and upstream changes that may affect reporting.
* Communicate findings and analytical results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

## Requirements

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* Experience working with healthcare or clinical research data, with an understanding of the complexity and sensitivity of healthcare data.
* Experience developing BI and analytics solutions using Zoho Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable BI platform.
* Strong SQL skills, with experience querying, joining, transforming, and validating data.
* Strong understanding of relational data modeling, including table relationships, keys, joins, cardinality, and the impact of data model design on reporting and aggregation.
* Experience building and maintaining datasets and data preparation or transformation workflows for reporting and analytics.
* Experience developing reports and dashboards for operational, analytical, and management use.
* Experience performing ad hoc data analysis to answer business questions.
* Understanding of good data management practices and the ability to apply them when developing BI and analytics solutions.
* Ability to investigate data discrepancies systematically and trace issues through different layers of a data solution.
* Experience modifying existing BI solutions safely, with an understanding of dependencies and downstream impact.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**

The Service Holder shall also assist the umbilical and flexible Specialists in all matters related to the Service Holder field of expertise.

The projects consist of Steel Lazy Wave Risers (SLWR), rigid flowlines and rigid spools in CS and CRA lined pipe (WOL/MLP/HRB) and rigid jumpers in Duplex, and associated subsea structures, equipment and ancillaries, for a very deep-water oil greenfield project.

The Service Holder will also provide support to the SURF Technical Manager and the SURF team and liaise with other project package teams (SPS and FPSO).

**ACTIVITIES**

· Promote & comply with all activities with applicable safety instructions and other company H3SE&Q rules, implement and control H3SE rules and requirements within his area of responsibility. Ensure all assigned technical documentation and SURF Contractor activities comply with H3SE&Q requirements and highlight any potential deviations. Ensure safe working practices are implemented along all phases of project

· Provide high level support services to ensure compliance with regards to the Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy, promote and enforce the Anti-Corruption Program within the Project,

· Be responsible for progress and timely delivery of the material selection, corrosion, welding and NDE/NDT during engineering and execution of technical package of the SURF EPCI Contract,

· Define, develop, issue and maintain all necessary technical documentation related to the material selection, corrosion, welding and NDE/NDT activities. Support and participate to the development and maintenance of Project Management main documents (SOR, FDP, PEP, PQP, Risks, etc.),

· Ensure follow-up / review / validation of progress performed by Contractor and its Suppliers with regards to his/her disciplines and analyze/report drifts that could occur and propose remedial solutions

This includes reviewing the in-place and installation analysis developed by the SURF Contractor and its Suppliers

· Raise consequently necessary comments and highlight unsafe design, deviations, unacceptable / unjustified design choices, constructability issues

· Act, as technical referent vis-à-vis Contractor(s) for material selection, corrosion, welding and NDE matters,

· Ensure follow-up and support for supervision of all testing and qualification activities (PQT, PPT, FAT, EFAT, SIT, etc.), fabrication activities at the various Contractor selected yards or Suppliers workshops and offshore pipeline installation activities,

· Ensure technical compliance throughout the Project life of the engineered, procured, fabricated, tested and installed flowlines / spools / jumpers material and equipment (over several locations, yards). Ensure all technical, QA/QC and H3SE project policies and requirements are duly implemented and ensure Contractors’ compliance with contractual requirements in all areas. Anticipate and ensure adequate and timely reporting to the Technical Manager of any concern, issue or potential deviation. Propose timely and adequate solutions and optimizations.

· Ensure that his/her work is in line with Material, Welding and NDT specialists of Company Headquarters,

· Attend to qualification/mechanical/laboratory tests related to welding and NDT scope as required,

· Review and approve PQT and WPS as required,

· Assist Company Representatives at fabrication/offshore sites, in particular:

· Witness of welding operations, welding operator qualification and equipment, including acceptance criteria;

· Review of NDE techniques and NDE Operatives and acceptance criteria;

· Assessment and evaluation of welding environment and facilities, including arrangements for personnel protection and HSE;

· Examination and assessment of materials and consumable

· Review and approval of any “Special Processes” (Heat Treatment, Induction Bending, Pickling, Passivating etc.) ...

· Liaise with other package teams (SPS, FPSO, etc.) for interface matters with the support of Interface Managers and leads,

· Organize and participate to Project Reviews,

· Assist and support the Technical Manager and the Subsea Manager on all aspects of the material selection, corrosion, welding and NDE related Call For Tender, Clarification & evaluation process, project execution and contracts management, and with the relations with Partners

· Coordinate with other Team Members including the SURF contract engineer for the follow-up of correspondence and contract activities throughout the full CFT process and during Project Execution

· Gather ‘lessons learnt’ and provide feedback to the client entities as required. Assist in the formalization of the close-out report

**CONTEXT & ENVIRONMENT**

The Venus Project is an oil project operated by the client in Namibian waters.

The Venus FPSO will operate in ultra-deepwater at roughly 3,000 m and is designed to process 160,000 bbl./d of oil with advanced systems to manage large volumes of associated gas, which will be re-injected to maintain reservoir pressure. The unit will be permanently spread-moored using a 16-line mooring system, engineered to ensure station-keeping in relatively harsh Atlantic conditions. The development includes up to 40 subsea wells tied back to the FPSO via the subsea architecture.

▪ International and multi-cultural environment.

• Positive, constructive, proactive and pragmatic mindset.

• Ability to work within large teams with other parties (Contractors, suppliers, HQ technical teams, etc.).

• Previous experience within a complex and multicultural working environment.

# Job Opening: Full Stack AI Software Engineer (Junior / Mid Level)

Voxly Digital builds full stack enterprise AI software for large multi clients.

Ravi Lal
·
21 March 2025
·4 min read

**TL;DR**

* At least 1 year React.ja / JavaScript.
* Full Stack Enterprise AI Projects.
* Long-Term Stability. Startup Vibe. Rapid Career Growth.
* 4-5 days a week in the office (Paddington, London).
* Salary Range: £40,000 - £50,000 + loads of benefits.
* Native English skills including amazing writing skills, etc.
* \*\*\* No Recruiters \*\*\*. Apply via Linkedin or freshthinking@voxlydigital.com

***Who Are We?***

Voxly Digital builds full stack enterprise AI software for large multi-national clients. We have annual retainers for bespoke AI and LLM-based projects with large players like Diageo, the UK Royal Navy, and Bristol Airport. We are based in Paddington, London, UK.

We mainly work in two product areas:

* AI for Conversational Marketing & Customer Self Service.
* AI for Intelligent Content & Marketing Compliance.

We are 100% bootstrapped, profitable, and have been in business for 6+ years. We're getting new customers all the time and our current roadmap is extensive.

Our mission is to drive enterprise transformation through AI and we are hiring because we need more core developers to support our expanding customer base.

***What You’ll Do***

As a Junior/Mid Full Stack AI Engineer, you will:

* Spend 50%-60% of your time on full-stack web development.
* Build responsive web apps with Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop RESTful APIs and server-side logic with Node.js.
* Integrate LLM APIs and manage databases, including vector databases.
* Master building intelligent Dialog Management for our services.
* Spend 10% - 20% on DevOps, deploying and managing applications on AWS.
* Spend 10% - 20% talking to customers to understand their challenges, present solutions, and gather feedback.

***Our Stack***

We make our apps with Next.js 14 App Router, deployed on AWS via SST. For LLM solutions, we use the suite of products offered by Langchain.

* Frontend: TypeScript, Next.js, React, HTML, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
* Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Langchain, Langgraph, Langsmith, OpenAI
* Authentication: Next Auth, Clerk, or we roll our own.
* Databases: DynamoDB, Chroma (Vector Database), Redis.
* Cloud: AWS + Azure. CloudFront, Lambda, S3, Eventbridge, Cloudwatch, SES and many more services which are mostly provisioned via SST.
* Analytics: Google Analytics 4.
* Version Control: Git, Bitbucket.

***Who You Are***

* You believe shipping = success, and is the most important KPI.
* You believe working should always feel like a great deal for both you and the company.
* You understand to get a great deal you need to create a lot of value for the company - you'll come on board to work hard, and in exchange have the opportunity to build and ship Enterprise Grade AI applications.
* You enjoy diving into new challenges, building innovative projects from the ground up.
* You relish solving hard problems - often through trial and error. If you shine, we'll give you loads of end to end responsibility.
* You are not a fan of Leetcode-style puzzles.
* You enjoy using AI tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude.
* You're willing to dive into the new world prompting - meaning you're ok for alot of trial and error before mastering this area.
* You enjoy talking to customers. You are patient and non-condescending – a clear and simple communicator.

***Minimum Requirements***

To be considered for this role you must have:

* 2+ years of related professional software engineering work experience.
* Understanding of client-server interactions and REST API development and deployment.
* Proficiency in React/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong knowledge of backend technologies, including Node.js, NoSQL/SQL databases, or BaaS.
* Some experience of hosting applications with AWS or similar Cloud provider/s.
* Fluency in English including very strong writing skills (come on ... prompting is super important right?).

***Preferences***

You'll have an edge over other applicants if you:

* Understand high-level AI concepts like vector databases, embeddings, RAG, etc. (Note: you do not need to be an ML expert).
* Have used new LLM frameworks like Langchain, Llama Index, Vercel AI SDK etc.
* ***Have a live side-project / personal site or other evidence demonstrating your ability to write code independently.***
* Have been using Next.js/React in production for over 1 year.
* Have experience with analytics tools such as Posthog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics.
* Have worked on enterprise software in production for over 1 year.
* Have experience of hosting and supporting production applications on AWS.
* Have AWS Cloud Certifications or experience deploying a Next.js site to AWS via SST.

***Work Location & Hours:***

Our team is office-based in Paddington from 9:30 - 6 PM, 5 days a week. We allow the occasional work-from-home day once you’ve established yourself – but the job is office based.

We believe this drives teamwork, efficiency, and rapid-learning. If you love collaborating and engaging with colleagues in person, you'll fit right in!

***Compensation & Benefits***

* Base Salary: £40,000 - £48,000 annually.
* Performance Reviews: Every 6 months for your first year, annually thereafter.
* Performance Bonuses: 10% of base salary annually (depending on personal and performance of course).
* Annual TFL Travel Card (Zone 1 and 2) worth £2000.
* 22.5 Days Paid Vacation
* Free ChatGPT+ & Github Copilot Subscription
* Free Lunch: Once a week (ish) at a nearby restaurant!
* Nest Pension: With a 3% employer match.
* Paddington Based Co-Working space away from the traffic and the noise. Close the canal's behind the station.

***Interview Process***

* 1x Video Call.
* 1x Take Home task (should take 1 evening)
* 1x In-Person Review - you’ll come into the office – show us what you’ve done – and we’ll ask you some questions about the task and your life!
* 1-2 reference calls, and then offer!
* To apply email us at freshthinking@voxlydigital.com

You’ll turn customer insight into compelling propositions and make sure everything we do builds a stronger, more distinctive brand.

Reporting to the VP of Brand, you’ll work closely with our Brand, Creative, Content, Growth and Product teams to deliver impactful marketing across our health categories.

* Connect brand and performance marketing, partnering closely with Paid and Growth teams so ideas translate effectively across channels, from mass awareness to conversion.

* Measure and optimise marketing effectiveness, working with Growth and Analytics to understand performance across brand and commercial metrics and apply learnings to future activity.
* Contribute to the wider brand marketing strategy, identifying opportunities to build awareness, consideration, trust and preference across Voy’s categories.
* Proactively identify opportunities to grow the brand, developing new initiatives, partnerships and creative ideas that build relevance, reach and consideration beyond major campaign moments.

**Who you are**

* An experienced brand marketer with 5+ years in brand marketing and a track record of developing and delivering integrated marketing activity across multiple channels.
* Strategic and creative in equal measure, able to uncover meaningful customer insights, develop compelling propositions and translate them into effective marketing.
* Creatively ambitious with excellent judgement, able to recognise powerful ideas, write inspiring briefs and work with creative teams and agencies to push work from good to great.

We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book — together with the client- and ops-facing surfaces that make them usable, from institutional onboarding and account configuration to reporting and the backoffice tooling our operations run on every day. You'll lead other engineers through problems of high ambiguity, set the technical bar for how we build for failure and not just the happy path, and follow a problem across the full institutional lifecycle rather than stopping at a boundary. Flexibility is the job: some weeks that's a settlement edge case in the backend, others a client onboarding flow or an ops dashboard, and you're happy owning whichever the work needs.

# Data Consultancy Executive

#### Why Walr?

Walr is the data collection company built for the fast and the ambitious. Founded in 2020, we exist to elevate the role of market researchers by removing the day-to-day heavy lifting so teams can focus on what matters: insight, recommendations, and impact. We do this through unmatched speed, and a unique blend of human expertise, proprietary technology and global audience reach.

Walr's success is driven by encouraging our people to think boldly, take ownership, and move fast together. We are now 180+ people across 4 continents, and only just getting started. Join Walr to be part of this growth story and create an industry-defining company in the process.

#### About The Role:

Walr is hiring a Data Consultancy Executive to join the European Team. You’ll own the delivery of projects through our ‘single point of contact’ (SPOC) delivery model, where one executive runs a project from start to finish, and you’ll support the wider team on our larger Full-Service projects.

This role is designed for someone at the start of their career. With training and support from experienced Data Consultants, you’ll quickly take full ownership of your own SPOC projects: programming the survey, managing fieldwork, checking the data and keeping the client informed throughout.

No previous market research experience is needed. We’re looking for someone curious, organised and detail-minded, who enjoys working with data and solving problems, and who is ready to take responsibility for their own client work.

Alongside your own projects, you’ll work with senior colleagues on Full-Service projects, building experience in running them end to end, which will set you up to progress.

#### Key Responsibilities:

##### Owning SPOC Projects

* Own the end-to-end delivery of your SPOC projects, from setup through survey programming, fieldwork and final data delivery, making sure they are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.
* Act as the client’s main point of contact on your projects, confirming requirements and timelines and giving clear, proactive updates.
* Program and test surveys using the Walr Platform and our automation tools, checking survey logic, routing and usability before launch.
* Manage live fieldwork, monitoring quotas, timelines and data quality, and working with sampling partners and internal teams when you need support.
* Quality-check final data and deliverables to make sure they are accurate and match client requirements.
* Spot issues early and resolve them, knowing when to bring in specialist teams or more experienced colleagues.

##### Supporting Full-Service Projects

* Support Data Consultants in delivering high-quality data to clients, contributing to a consultative, service-led client experience.
* Help align internal teams and clients on survey design, sample plans, timelines and deliverables, and suggest improvements along the way.
* Support survey programming setup by testing surveys alongside our internal programmers, checking they are fit for purpose, on time and error free.
* Help monitor sampling and data collection with the sampling team, tracking quotas and flagging where field strategy or timelines may need adjusting.
* Work with our data processing team to check that final data deliverables are on time, error free and meet client specifications.
* Contribute to client communication by preparing regular updates, and learn how to anticipate client needs, advise on trade-offs and escalate appropriately.
* Build a strong knowledge of the Walr proposition, and of how our technology, audiences and team of experts come together to meet client needs.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by suggesting ways to improve the end-to-end data collection process, and by sharing client feedback with our product and technology teams.
* With coaching from Data Consultants, grow towards owning simple Full-Service projects end to end.

#### What We’re Looking For

* A degree, or equivalent experience, in any discipline. Subjects with a numerical, analytical or social science element are useful but not essential.
* A genuine interest in data, research and how businesses use insight to make decisions.
* Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach: you take care to get things right.
* Logical thinking and an aptitude for problem solving, with the curiosity to pick up technical tools quickly.
* A good working knowledge of Excel or similar. Any exposure to survey tools, coding, SPSS, Python or AI tools is a bonus, but not required.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the confidence to be a client’s main point of contact.
* Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage several projects and deadlines at once.
* A proactive, positive attitude and the confidence to take ownership of your own projects, while knowing when to ask for help.

#### What You’ll Get:

* Structured training across survey programming, fieldwork management and data quality.
* Day-to-day support and mentoring from experienced Data Consultants.
* Your own client projects to run from early on, plus exposure to larger Full-Service work.
* A clear path to progress to Data Consultant as your experience and responsibilities grow.

* **We Delight through Dedication**  
  We go the extra mile, stay focused, and fix what’s not working. Fast.
* **We Lead with Trust**  
  We trust each other’s judgment and act with integrity. Always as partners.
* **We Revel in Innovation**  
  We challenge the status quo and try new ways forward. Progress over perfection.
* **We Celebrate as a Team**  
  We share wins, support each other, and believe we’re better as a collective.
* **We Are Empowered to Act Like Owners**  
  We take responsibility, make bold calls, and think big-picture.

We’re building a workplace that works for everyone.
